Ore pee edol kulikae ayiok ajo kenyor menye Yosef oleng’ alang’ ninche naa keibaa Yosef oleng’. Ore pee eliki Yosef ninche inkidetidet enye enaikununo enkitoria enye te ninche neponiki enkiba enye.
Ore enkolong’ nabo nelo Yosef enetii ilalashera lenyena tenebo intare.

Neiyieu ilalashera near Yosef kake ore te siadi etimirakaki Yosef ilamirak oopuoito Misiri. Ore pee eidip atimir nepik osarge le nkine olkila le Yosef pee elej menye enaikununo enkeeye e Yosef etiu anaa etaara eng’wuesi olayioni lenye.

Ore te Misiri eiyang’ua Potifa Yosef metaa osinka lenye. Neisiayia Yosef Potifa esidai neyau emayianata enkang’ enye kake etanang’akaki korokoroni tenkaraki elejare e nkitok e Potifa. Ata tiatua korokoroni etamayiana Enkai ninye. Neidim aibelekenya inkidetidet oo ltung’ana oopasha. Ore enkolong’ nabo netum olkingi Farao enkidetidet nainyala indamunot enyena oleng’. Neipot Yosef maeu aibelekeny enkidetidet enye. Neliki Yosef ajo nepuono ilarin oopishana oo intumot sidain pee etum indaiki kumok. Nesuj sii kulo arin kulikae arin oopishana lo lameyu torrono. Neshipayu Farao oleng’ neishoo Yosef eaku olkitok le Misri pooki pee erik Misiri tiatua kulo arin.

Ore pee elotu olameyu ketii sii olameyu e nkop e Kanaan, ewueji enetii Yakobo o ilayiok lenyena. Kake etoning’o ninche ajo ketii endaa Misiri tenkaraki enkipang’ata sidai e Yosef. Neirriwaa Yakob ilayiok lenye Misiri aaingóru endaa. Ore pee ebaiki Misiri, neiyolou Yosef ninche kake meyiolou ninche Yosef.

Tenepuonu enetii Yosef negil kung’ te dukuya ninye. Ore pee elusoo erishata nedol Yosef ajo keata ilalashera lenyena osina sapuk amu etimira Yosef apa te sinkaisho neiyieu neirridu. Neing’urie ninye ninche nejoki. “Kara nanu olalashe linyi Yosef, ilo apa litimirakita enkop e Misiri. Kake ore naa taata emiureishoyu anaa igororo maate, tenkaraki nikitimirakita apa ena kop; amu Enkai apa naaiturukunye nanu maeu aitopok enkishui amu etijing’a olameyu enkop too larin oopishana. Naairriu apa Enkai ene pee aituruku ten tae, pee alotu aitajeu ilekunot ten kop naitasheyie tenkaraki intae pee meye ilkumok. Metaa mme intae apa likirriutua ene kake Enkai; naaeuo aaitaa olkitok oitore enkop pooki e Msiri.”

Ore te siadi, neipoto menye Yakobo meeu Misiri tenebo olmarei pooki. Ore pee elusoo ilarin tomon oopishana neye Yakobo. Nejo ilalashera le Yosef, “Ebaiki taa neibayu iyiook Yosef neitalak iyiook enapa lap nikintaasa iyiook ninye.” Metaa eirriwaitie ninche olkilikuai aairriwaki Yosef ejoki, “Tapalaki iyiook te eng’oki ang’, amu kitaasa entorroni te iyie.”

Kake etiaka Yosef ninche, “Emiureshoyu, katii nanu ewueji e Nkai? Ore te intae, naa entorroni apa kiyiewuakiki; kake eitaa ninye Enkai esidai, pee etum aitopuaa iltung’ana kumok anaa enatiu ena olong’. Metaa emiureishoyu; kaisho intae eretoto tenebo o nkera inyi.” Neijia eikuna aitisipaki ninche neitagol ninche.

cbs/ma/einoto-e-musa-i-enkisikata-enye.title: EINOTO E MUSA I ENKISIKATA ENYE
paragraphs: Neye Yosefu naa ore tiatua ilarin iip ong’uan nebul olmarei le Yakobo oleng’ te lalai neipoti ninche ajo olosho loo Siraeli. Neipoti sii aajo Ilhebrania… Ore teine nepuku, nebulu olaiguanani ng’ejuk leitu aekata eyiolou Yosefu. Ore pee edol ajo kumok ele osho loo Siraeli oleng’, neureshoyu. Nelotu aitaa ninche arashu neitaa ninche isinkan. Neureishoyu ajo ebaiki nedumakino ninche Ilmisiri, neidimu ninche o meitayu enkitanapata metaari pooki ayioni naini to Siraeli te ina olong’ eini ninye. Kake ore inkatoyiok o Ilhebrania neany ening’ enkitanapat e Farao.
Nerrip Enkai ninche neponari Ilhebrania te siana sapuk.

Netii apa olmare loo Siraeli oing’uaa olgilata le Lawi oat apa enkiti ayioni sidai. Neisudoo ninye tiatua empeut kiti neitadoiki ina peut atua olkeju le Nail. Ore Miriam, ina anashe botorr eina ayioni, neisudori pee edol enaikuna olalashe lenye kiti.

Ore teina rishata, nelotu entito olkinki le Misiri adou olkeju le Nail tenebo olchoreta lenyena, nedol ina kerai, neya ninye aitaa enkerai enye nedung’oki ninye enkarna ajo Musa. Nelotu Miriam enetii entito o Lkinki, neikilikuan ninye “Iyieu naing’uraki enkitok o Siraeli, pee kilotu aibung’aki ena kerai?” nejoki ninye ina tito o lkinki, “Ee ing’urakaki enkitok o Siraeli naa kalak ninye maing’uraki ena kerai.” Neishoori Musa ng’otonye enye meibung’a ninye. Ore pee ebulu enkerai aaku botorr, neya ng’otonye ayaki entito e Farao, neaku enkerai enye, nebul Musa te nkaji olkinki le Misiri.

Ore pee eaku Musa olee, ore nabo olong’ enetii iltung’ana lenye loo Siraeli. Ore teine nedol Olmisiri earita oltung’ani loo Siraeli. Neing’orisho nemelioo likae tung’ani too nchot pooki. Near Musa Olmisiri metua, neisudoo osesen lenye.
Neyiolouni ina bae, neisik musa alo aisudori torpukel.
Nedol Enkai olosilisili loo iltung’ana lenyena Isiraeli, nedamu Enkai olmumai oinos tialo Abraham, Isaka o Yakobo.

cbs/ma/enkipototo-e-musa-o-esanag-nayupu.title: ENKIPOTOTO E MUSA O ESANAG NAYUPUYUP
paragraphs: Ore pee eeye Yosef, netumi likae kinki te Misiri lemeyiolo Yosef. Naa keure Israeli neitaa ninche irrindiki. Neitayu enkitanapata nchere ore pooki ayioni naaini tiatua Israeli neari metua. Neisudoo olmarei obo loo Lawi enkerai enye ayioni tiatua enkikapu nepik ninye atua olkeju le Nail. Netum enkayioni entito olkinki neitubulu ninye anaa enkerai enye. Nebulu Musa tiatua enkaji o lkinki. Kake ore enkolong’ nabo near metua oltung’ani loo Lmisiri oorit apa oltung’ani loo Sraeli.
Neisik Musa alo olpurkel.
Ore apa Musa naa o loo larin artam pee eisik te Misiri. Nebik to lpurkel kulikae arin artam neyam Zippora, entito o lapolosani Yethro le Midian.

Ore enkolong’ nabo, egira Musa airrita intare o laputani lenye te mbata Oldoinyo le Sinai. Neipang’aki ninye olmalaika lo Laitoriani te nkima esanag naiyupuyup. Kake nedol Musa enkima te sanag kake menya ninye. Neing’asia ninye Musa nenyikaki alo aing’or. Neipot Olaitoriani ninye tiatua ina sanag nejo, “Musa, Musa!”
Newaliki Musa ajo, “Nele nanu.”

Nejoki Enkai, “Milotu anyiku. Intayu namuka amu aisinyati ene nintasheyie.” Nejoki, “Ara nanu Enkai e papai lino Abraham o Enkai e Isak o Enkai e Yakobo.” Ore pee ening’ ina, neisudoo Musa enkomom enye amu meitiu aing’ura Enkai.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Atodua osina loo ltung’ana laainei o sinkaisho tiatua enkop e Misiri. Kayieu naitajeu ninche nayau ninche enkop enkisiligata. Kaairriwa iyie. Shomo enetii Farao, olkinki le Misiri, pee intayu iltungana lainei le Israel aitung’uaa Misiri.”
Kake nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Amaa kara nanu ng’ae olo enetii Farao aitayu iltung’ana lo Israeli aitung’uaa Misiri?”
Nejoki Enkai Musa, “Atii nanu tenebo iyie. Naa keaku ena olmonekie te iyie pee aaitodol ajo nanu laairriwaa: ore pee intayu iltung’ana aitung’uaa enkop e Misiri nikiserememe nanu tele doinyo.”
Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Amaa tenalo enetii iltung’ana loo Siraeli naajoki ninche, ‘Enkai e papai linyi naairriwua nanu’ naaikilikuan ninche aajoki, ‘Keijiaa enkarna enye?’ Kaa ajoki ninche?”
Nejoki Enkai Musa, “ARA NANU ILO ORA.” Naa ena tiaki ninche. “KARA NANU laairriwua nanu enitii.’”
Kake nejo Musa, “Kake o tenemaairuk nanu?”

Neibung’ita Musa eng’udi te nkaina enye. Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Irragie ina ng’udi ten kop.” Neiko Musa neijia neaku eng’udi olasurai! Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Tudumu imbung’a olkidong’oi.” Neibung’ Musa neitoki aaku eng’udi. Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Tipika enkaina ino atua olkila. Ore pee eitayu neibung’a enkeeya oo lbolot. Kake ore pee eitoki ashukoki atua olkila neishiuu. Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Pee intodol ninche kuna kitoduat pee eiruk nchere Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papai lenye linkimpang’aka iyie.”
Nenyorra Musa neshuko alo enkop e Misiri.

cbs/ma/ilmeita-le-dukuya-oudo-tenkop-e-m.title: ILMEITA LE DUKUYA OUDO TENKOP E MISIRI
paragraphs: Ore ake peyie epuonu Musa o lalashe lenye Aaron atumuro ilpayiani kituak loo Siraeli nepuo enetii Farao, nejoki “Etejo Enkai O Siraeli inji, ‘Inchoo iltung’ana lainei epuo pee aitobiraki osirua.’”

Nejoki Farao ninche “kaing’ae Olaitoriani? Mayiolo nanu ninye, nemaisho sii ninche meshomo. Kainyioo pee iyaya iltung’ana aitung’uaa esiai enye? Enchom!” negoro Farao neitoki aitagol esiai enye. Neishiraki ninche Musa.

Neomon Musa Enkai, nejoki Enkai ninye “Shomo tiaki Isiraeli, ‘Atoning’o olkiyioi linyi naa kaitajeu intae te kulo Misiri. Kaitaa intae iltung’ana lainei naa kayau intae ina kop apa naisiligie Abraham, O Isaka tenebo Yakobo.” Neigil Musa o Aaron ashukokino Farao, neiteru taa imbaa aasa tialo olaiguanani le Misiri o Enkai O Siraeli. Ore enedukuya neng’as ninye Aaron aitodolu olmonokie aibelekeny eng’udi metan olasurai kake eitu eiruk Farao, neany eisho nena kera o Siraeli epuo. Neiterunye taa ilmeita. Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye te shumata nkariak e Misiri newal inkariak natii ilkejek, ilturot, inong’ot, mugarri, olchorroi neaku pooki osarge. Ore inkariak natii atua ioketa oo nkeek o ioketa o soito neaku osarge. Ore isinkirr pooki otii olkeju neye nenguoyi olkejuk – neitagol Enkai ottau le Farao.
Neitoki Enkai airriu olmeitai loo nduani e nkare enkop pooki neigil Farao aipotu Musa. “Toomono Enkai meiwuangi kuna tuain, naa kaisho intae ipuopuo.” Neas Musa ina. Kake neibekenya Farao.

Neigil Aaron ailepie eng’udi enye, ore enterit pooki e Misiri neala aaku enkojong’ani. Ore looti ang’eni otaasa kulikae bulabul, kake nelaikino ataas nena, Nejo “ilang’eni Olkimojino le Nkai ele!” kake eitu ake ening Farao.

Neirriu Enkai kulikae meita tialo ile Misiri kake eitu eshoroo inkera oo Siraeli pooki (ore ilojong’a, enkeeya o nkishu, ildututa, enchan o soito, olmaati enaimin) ore te pooki rishata nejo ake Farao “Ayia” ore pee elotu olmeitai, kake nemetiki eisho Isiraeli epuo tenelusoo olmetai.

Nejoki taa Enkai Musa “Aitagolo oltau le Farao pee atumoki aitamio ninche tenkaraki inkaitin enye. Agira aas kulo moniek pee iliki inkera inono o noo nkakuyia inono, niyiolou sii ajo ara Olaitoriani. Kayieu nayau likae meitai obo, naa kelo Farao araa intae pii.”

cbs/ma/engiroroto.title: ENGIROROTO
paragraphs: Ore pee eidip Enkai arriu imleita naudo, nejoki Enkai Musa, “Aitagolo oltau le Farao pee aitame Ilmisiri too nkaitin enye. Aasita kuna kitoduat pee ilikiki inkera oo inkera oo loo kakuyia linyi pee iyiolou nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani.
Naa kairriu likae meitai obo neisho intae Farao impang’ipang’a tena kop.

Entoning’u entobiraki. Ore pooki marei neitayu olkuo obo le kerr aashu ole kine lemeata entibili lo lari obo neiyieng’ eton eitu emisimisu. Neitadoiki hysopo atua osarge neisuaki intaloishin e kutuk aji. Ninyianya inkiri naatapejoki te nebo imukateni neitu eisuijieki ninyiaya sii mbenek naadua. Nitonini tiatua inkajijik too lmonokie loo sarge o mekenyu. Enosa entasioki inchopitoto inkilani inyi.

Amu kaim atua enkop e Misri naar metuata ilkikaunot pookin pee aitame Ilmisiri tenkaraki inkaitin enye. Kake ore pee adol osarge too intaloishin e kutuk aji naa kalo agiroo intae. Nimbung’ubung’u aitaa osirua lo Laitoriani tiatua eishoritin inyi pooki te pooki ari. Ore eikilikuan intae inkera inyi nchere ‘Kainyoo tipat e ina?’ entoliki ninche nchere, “Tena olong’ apa, eitayu iyiook Olaitoriani aitung’uaa sinkaisho ten kop e Misiri.’”

Neas Isiraeli anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninche. Ore te mpolos enkewarie nelo Olaitoriani aim atua Misiri near pooki kikaunot te pooki aji o metabaiki olkikau le Farao. Kake ore pee edol Enkai osarge lo lkuo le kerr too nkutukie oo nkajijik oo inkera oo Isiraeli, negiroo ninche. Neton apa kewarie pee eipot Farao Musa tenebo o Haron. Nejoki, “Ewaita pooki toki inyi. Enchom!” Ore iltung’ana le latia loo Lmisiri nejo, “Ee, enchom pee mikiiye.” Neisho sii ninche inkarsisisho anaa sahabu o enkosholai o masaa anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani Musa o Abraham apa. Ore ina olong’, nekordu Enkai iltung’ana lenyenak tenkop e Misiri.

cbs/ma/elangata-enaiposha-nanyokie.title: ELANG’ATA ENAIPOSHA NANYOKIE
paragraphs: Ore pee eidip Enkai atokordu Isiraeli tenkop e Misiri, nerikoo ninche te nkatampoi eng’ape te dama, nerikoo te nkatapampoi enkima te nkewarie. Eitu erikoo ninche aitorioki enkop e Kanaan, kake nerikoo ninche to lpurkel tembata enaiposha nanyokie. Nejo Enkai, “Kedamu Farao ajo kelaikino Isiraeli aashom. Nesujaa Farao ninche, kake katum enkitoo makewan eimu Farao o enjore enye. Neiyiolou Ilmisiri nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

Ore pee eyiolou Farao ajo eshomoita ninche, nejo, “Kainyoo kitaasa? Kinchoo irrindiki lang’ epuo pesho!” Neya ingarin oo mbartan o njore enye nesujaa ninche iltung’ana loo Siraeli, neinepu ninche tembata enaiposha nanyokie. Nelaikino Isiraeli aaisika.
Ore pee edol iltung’ana loo Siraeli Ilmisiri etinyikutua neureishoyu oleng’.

Nejoki Musa, “Musa, ainyoo pee iyaua iyiook olpurkel mayetu aidaaya. Amu enaikash apa te iyiook tenikisiai Emisiri alang’ tenkieye to lpurkel!” Nejoki Musa iltung’ana, “Emiureishoyu. Entashoito katukul metii orng’ash pee idolidolo enjeunoto Olaitoriani. Amu ore kulo Misiri lidolitata taata mintokiki aikata aadol. Amu kejing’ Olaitoriani olarrabal tenkaraki intae metaa entirring’ata.”

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tudumu ilepie eng’udi ino nintorioo enkaina ino te shumata enaiposha toosho, pee etum iltung’ana loo Siraeli aashom tenkop natoyio te mpolos e naiposha. Neitashe enkatampoi eng’ape te rishata enye o Lmisiri.
Neitorio Musa enkaina enye te shumata enaiposha neor Olaitoriani Enaiposha Nanyokie nepuku enkop natoyio. Nepuo iltung’ana loo Siraeli aaim enkop natoyio etii esunta e nkare te tatene o te kedienye.

Nesujaa ninche Ilmisiri tiatua enkotoi natoyio. Ore tadekenya enasirie neisirng’ang’ie Olaitoriani enjore oo Lmisiri, aun nkejek oo ngarrin enye metupurpurro te lototo; nejo Ilmisiri, “Emaisika te dukuya Iloosiraeli; amu kemitu ninche Olaitoriani aing’arraki Ilmisiri.”

Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino te shumata enaiposha, pee eshukunye enkare shumata Ilmisiri, o shumata ingarrin enye oo mbartan. Neas neijia. Neshukunye inkariak neimisie ingarrin oo mbartan o ina jore pooki e Farao; eitu ninye eleku obo lenye.

Neiko neijia Olaitoriani aitajeu Isiraeli ina olong’ too nkaik oo Lmisiri; nedol Isiraeli Ilmisiri etuata te mbata e naiposha. Nedol Isiraeli esiaai sapuk naitaasa Olaitoriani Ilmisiri, neureyu iltung’ana Olaitoriani; neiruk ninche Olaitoriani olaisiaayiani lenye Musa.

cbs/ma/oldoinyo-le-sinai-o-inkitanapat-t.title: OLDOINYO le SINAI o INKITANAPAT TOMON
paragraphs: Ore pee elusoo ilapaitin aare pee epuku iltung’ana loo Siraeli te Misiri neun ilng’oborri te dukuya o Ldoinyo le Sinai. Neilep Musa alo oldoinyo, nejoki Enkai ninye, “Tiaki inkera oo Siraeli, ‘Itoduaa intae maate enaikuna pee aitajeuo intae aitung’uaa enkop e Misiri. Tenikianyititi intae katukul nimbung’ubung’u olning’o lai lo sotua, ore tiatua iloshon pooki niakuku intae iltung’ana laainei le tipat, enkitoria oo lapolosak o losho sinyati.” Ore pee ejoki Musa ninche neijia, nejo ninche, “Aikias pooki tooki natiaka iyiook Olaitoriani.”

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaki iltung’ana meitisinya ate tiatua inkolong’i are amu kalotu te nkolong’ euni. Mincho oltung’ani hoo obo meibung’a oldoinyo ashu eye amu eisinyati ine.” Ore te nkolong’ euni, nedou enkatampoi nairrusha shumata oldoinyo tenebo o nkiwuang’at o ndarat, nepuku oltoilo laijo ole intarumpeta. Neikirikira oldoinyo. Neikirikira sii iltung’ana te nkuretisho. Neilep Musa alo oldoinyo neisho Enkai ninye inkitanapat tomon. Nejo:
Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino laaitayio aitung’uaa sinkaisho.

Neikirikira iltung’ana pooki. Nejoki Musa, “Musa, irorie iyie iyiook amu aikining’. Kake inchoo metaa me Enkai nairorie iyiook mikiye.” Nejoki Musa, “Miureishoyuyu. Keyieu Enkai niureyuyu ninye pee miasiasa ing’ok.” Neishoru Olaitoriani kulie kitanapat pee erikoo ninche anaa olosho loo Siraeli.

Ore te nkolong’ nasujita ina, neshet Musa olperere neitayu olasar lo sarge nejo, “Osarge ele lo lning’o oitobira Olaitoriani tenkaraki intae.” Nejo ninche, “Ekias pooki toki anaa enetejo Olaitoriani.” Neitoki aailep Musa tenebo o Yoshua enchumata oldoinyo, neisho Enkai Musa isoito aare dapashi tenebo inkitanapat naaigero Enkai to lkimojino lenye.

cbs/ma/olashe-lo-suyai.title: OLASHE lo SUYAI
paragraphs: Ore pee eidip atoliki Isiraeli inkitanapat tomon, neilep Musa alo oldoinyo airorie Olaitoriani too nkolong’i artam. Ore pee edol iltung’ana ajo eimutie Musa to ldoinyo, nepuonu enetii Haron nejoki ninye, “Intobiraki iyiook inkaitin naapuo te dukuya iyiook. Amu mikiyiolo enataase te Musa.” Neitayu iltung’ana pooki ilgiso loo nkiyaa enye neyaki pooki Haron. Neya Haron lelo giso neitobirunyie olashe lo suyai. Nejoki ninche, “Kuna taa inkaitin inyi naaitaituo intae te nkop e Misiri.” Ore te shumata oldoinyo neitobiru Enkai kulie soito are dapashi o inkitanapat. Ore pee eidip aitobiru ninche nejoki Musa, “Eidipa iltung’ana laainei aaibelekenyata naaing’uaa nanu. Shomo tung’uaiyoki pee amut ninche!” Kake etasayia Musa Olaitoriani aitadamu olning’o lenye te rishata e Abraham, Isaak, o Yakobo pee memut iltung’ana lenyena.

Ore pee edoyio Musa to ldoinyo nedol iltung’ana eseremita olashe lo suyai negoro oleng’. Nenang’aa lelo soito aare dapashi nebelibel ninche. Nebuak to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Ore pooki ng’ai oserem Enkai nasipa inchoo elotu enatii!” Ore tiatua iloshon pokira tomon oare loo Siraeli, nepuku olosho obo lo Lawi. Nejoki Musa ninche, “Entudumu pooki ilalema entumut lelo pooki ooserem olashe lo suyai!” Neye iltung’ana kumok teina olong’. Neirridu kulikae tung’ana ing’ok enye. Neitoki Musa ashuko alo oldoinyo aishiraki Enkai metapaliki ninche too ng’ok enye. Neitoki Enkai aisho Musa kulie soito aare dapashi o inkitanapat tomon. Naa nena kitanapat apa etipika Musa atua Osanduku lo Sotua. Ore te rishata naado to Ldoinyo le Sinai, neitoki Olaitoriani ariko ninche Isiraeli aitorioki Enkop e Nkisiligata.

cbs/ma/olngobor-lo-laitoriani-o-enkolong.title: OLNG’OBOR LO LAITORIANI o ENKOLONG’ ENKITUTUMOTO
paragraphs: Ore pee eidip Isiraeli airridutu te seremata o lashe lo suyai, neaku erishata naitobiri ewueji netumore Enkai o ltung’ana lenyenak. Keji olng’obor. Ore pee enyorraa iltung’ana pooki too ltauja lenye neyau pooki enkishorot sidain pee easishore ilaisiyiaak. Neyau inkishorot kumok oleng’ o metaa nejoki Musa ninche entapal amu iyautua enaaidip esiai pooki. Ore pee eidipayu enchatata olng’obor, neitoip enkatampoi shumata olng’obor neiput enkitoo e Nkai atua ilo ng’obor.
Nebik enkatamboi te shumata olng’obor te rishata naado. Naa ina kata ake epuo iltung’ana loo Siraeli tenelo enkatampoi.

Ore olng’obor naa aisapuk oleng’ neata ilgilat oare. Ore olgilata le dukuya naa Ewueji Sinyati. Ore tiatua ilo gilata netii olperere lo lasar le nkorropil, netii emisa natii imukatini tomon aare te risioroto o loshon loo Isiraeli, netii sii inkitashet o ltaa e sahabu nasila. Ore tedialo olkarasha netii likae gilata oji Ewueji Sinyati oo Sinyat. Ore tiatua ilo gilata netii Osanduku lo Sotua. Ore tiatua ilo sanduku netii nena soitok aare naaigerore inkitanapat tomon.

Nejo Olaitoriani meetae likae tung’ani oibung’ intokitin sinyat meteleku ilapolosak ake naa teneibung’ naa keye. Neput Musa Haron, olalashe lenye metaa Olapolosani Kitok tenebo o eishoi oo Lawi pee eretisho te nkisiayiare o lng’obor nenap intokitin oo lng’obor te rishata enaidurra.

Ore anaake teipa o tedekenya neiyieng’ ilapolosak olkuo lemeata entioto nepej te shumata olperere lo lasar. Naa tenegil oltung’ani nabo oo inkitanapat neyau olkuo le kerr aashu ole kine anaa olasar loo ng’ok. Ore te rishata nabo to lari, te Enkolong’ e Nkitutumoto, neyauni inkineji aare o loing’oni. Neiyieng’i oloing’oni o nkine nabo, nesuakini osarge shumata o Sanduku lo Sotua pee elak ing’ok olapolosani tenebo inoo ltung’ana loo Siraeli. Neibalunye Olapolosani ing’ok oo ltung’ana eibung’ita elukunya enkae kine neyai enkop nalakua olpurkel metaa meitoki ashukunye neya ing’ok pooki oo ltung’ana teilo ari. Meetae ae oitoi naitayunye iltung’ana ing’ok enye meteleku enkoitoi naishoo Enkai ninche.

Ore etii nena pooki, neton ake egolong’aki iltung’ana Olaitoriani. O metabaiki ninye ilayiok le Haron amu eitu eanyit neitu easisho aaitobiraki aapej enkorropil tiatua Ewueji Sinyati. Neirriu Enkai enkima naing’uaa shumata nepej ninche tiatua ilo ng’obor. Nejoki Musa Haron, “Eidipa oshiake Enkai aikoo iyiook pee ejo, “Ore pooki laaisiai nanu neishiakino neanyit esinyatisho ai.”

cbs/ma/ilaikitalak-orpurkel-engudi-o-suy.title: ILAIKITALAK, ORPURKEL, ENG’UDI O SUYAI NATAA OLASURAI, ENKOP E NKISILIGATA
paragraphs: Ilaikitalak tomon o are ooshomo aikitalan Kanaan:

Ore pee eidip aishoo Enkai Musa inkitanapat toldoinyio le Sinai, nerretena iltung’ana pee ejing Kanaan amu ena apa enkisiligata naishoo Enkai Abraham, Isaak, O Yakobo. Neirriwaa Musa ilaikitalak tomon o are obo ake tiatua lelo gilat, nepuo ninche tiatua ina kop too nkolongi artam egira ayiolou enaika tenerasaki ina kop.

Ore pee eshukunyie lelo aikitalak, nenyorrakino pooki inchere ore Kanaan naa enkop napirr, naruko kule o naishi, kake ore tomon lenye neyau ilkiliku torrok inchere ore iltung’ana leina kop, o suntan e ina kop naa sapuki oleng’, negol sii, nemeidim ake Isiraeli atimirr ninche. Ore ilaikitalak aare, Yoshua o Kaleb, neiruko ninche inchere kemirr ina kop to larrabal lelo mang’ati lenye, amu keretu iyiook Enkai anaa enaikuna te Misiri. Kake negolong’u olorere neany ejing.

Negoro Enkai oleng’, neyau enkiguana shumata ninche Isiraeli. Neibalunyie sii ina rishata ajo inchere meata obo oitogiroyie ilarin tikitam ojing atua ina kop, enkisiligata. Naa kepuo sii Israeli aman orpukel o metuata ina ishoi pooki – ilarin artam.
Ilarin artam torpurkel/entoki neitu enyorraa Isiraeli

Neaku nemanaa Isiraeli. Nerikoo ninche Musa naa ore too rishat pooki neisho Enkai ninche endaa (manna o ingurlen naing’uaa keperr) o enkare tenkoitoi e nking’asia. Kake neingunyunguny ake olorere. Ore kulie rishat neingunyungunyaki Musa ejo “Kainyioo pee iyawua iyiook te Misiri pee kipuonu aye tele purkel? Amu mikiata enkare o mukateni – nimikiyieu manna!”

Negero olaitoriani. Neirriu ilasuria atua olerere neiteru aony ninche. Neiteru olorere aaye nepuonu enetii Musa nejoki, “ kitaasa iyiook eng’oki aingunyungunyaki Enkai tenebo iyie. Tasayiaki iyiook Olaitoriani, meiwuangakinyie iyiook kulo asuriaa.” Neomonoki Musa iltung’ana.

Nejoki Enkai Musa meitayu enkitanyaanyukoto olasurai lo suyai obo neik ninye te shumata olchata. Ore ake pooki ng’ae oony olasurai, ore ake pee eing’or ilo asurai lo suyai, nejeu. Neitayu Musa olasurai lo suyai nepik te shumata ilo shata.
Ore ake pee eony pooki ng’ae olasurai, ore ake pee eing’or ilo asurai lo suyai, nepok.
Enjing’ata e Nkop e Nkisiligata:
Ore enabayie, etulusoitie ilarin artam tiatua orpurkel, neyau Enkai Isiraeli olpolosie leina kop e nkisiligata. Nelo Enkai agelu Yoshua metoriko ninche ina kop.

Ore eton eitu eye Musa, neitadamua iltung’ana pee meserem ake aekata inkitanyaanyukot naitae inkaitin natii Kanaan, pee mewuasai ake nerikino ninche ing’ok enye, neitadamu ninche pee edamu enyorrata e Nkai, o enkisiligata naishoo Abraham, Isaka o Yakobo. Neibung’ ilo ning’o teneyieu nemayiani. Neitadamu
ninche inchere keitame ninche Enkai tenepuo Aserem kulie aitin, kake ore ake pee eirridu, neing’oru Olaitoriani, nening ninye, neing’urrie ninche Enkai.
Ore eyia nejia, ore tialo erikore e Yoshua, nelang olosho loo Siraeli eim atua olkeju le Yordan ten kop natoyio neiteru arasaki ina kop.

cbs/ma/ilaiguanak.title: ILAIGUANAK
paragraphs: Ore anaa pee eirish, neidimu Isiraeli, iltung’ana le Kanaan, neya ilgilat pokira tomon o are ina kop. Neaku esiai apa enye pee earaa iltung’ana pooki otii atua Kanaan leton apa etii atua ina kop, peyie meshulare ake ninche, neiteru ainyial ninche nena kitanyaanyukot naseremi. Ore peyie eidip Yoshua atua, neitore ate ilgilat le Isiraeli. Ore peyie eiteru ashipakino, neiteru sii akarsisu teina kop ng’ejuk, nerikino ina apa naitanapa ninche Enkai. Inji kiindim atejo ina rishata: “neas pooki tung’ani enaba anaa enayieu too nkonyek enyana.”

Nejoki Olmalaika lo Laitoriani iltung’ana, “Ore peyie aitayu intae aitung’uaa Misiri natiaka intae, “Eminchosho ake ile Kanaani emany enkop tenebo intae.” Kake itigila intae ilo ning’o tialo iyiook. Inchoo Ilkanaani eshulare intae, neitu igiligili ilperere lenye, neitu ipejoo inkaitin enye. Neaku, mekure sii nanu araa ninche teina kop inyi. Keaku ninche olkikuei te ntae, nerresh intae nkaitin enye.”

Naa ina ake nataase. Nerikino ina ishoi pooki kiti Enkai. Neiteru aaserem inkaitin oo ilkanaani, neas imbususi. Neiteru ilmangati airish ninche, neaku ore pooki kata napuo Isiraeli olarrabal, negilunore ninche Enkai, nemiri ninche. Ore pee eitoki aaku isinkan eniare, nedamu ninche Enkai, neipot neomon ninye meeu aitajeu ninche. Nedumu Enkai olarikoni, oji olarishani, oitajewuo ninche aigil.

Kake ore tenkiti rishata, nerikino ninche Enkai. Neiterunye emanaroto aigil naijo enkae. Katitin tomon oo ng’uan eitu ninye ebaya iip uni o onom, neitoki inkera o Siraeli aibelekenya aing’uaa Enkai neiteru aaserem inkaitin o Ilkanaani! Ore te pooki rishata, neitame ninche Enkai anaa apake enatejo pee eisho ninche inkitanapat tomon toldoinyio le Sinai. Kake ore te pooki kata nairridu inkera o Siraeli tialo eng’oki enye neibung olning’o, nepaliki Enkai ninche. Neiteru Enkai amayian ninche aigil. Naa keji ena, erishata oo larishak. Ore kulikae arishak arashu aitajeunok naa ketii Gidion, Debora tenebo Samson. Ore apa olobayie naa Emmanuel.

cbs/ma/etayieutua-isirael-olaiguanani-ol.title: ETAYIEUTUA ISIRAEL OLAIGUANANI – OLAIGUANANI SAULO O ILMALEKI
paragraphs: (Ore apa olarishani obayie oitajewuo inkera olosho loo Siraeli naa keji Samuel. Ore apa aa enkayioni, neirorie Enkai ninye neliki ninye imbaa naasa to nkolongi napuonu. Ore apa egira abulu, netii apa Enkai tenebo o ninye, naa ore apa pooki natejo nepuonu asipayu, neyiolou olosho pooki ajo oloiboni le Nkai ilo.)
Ore pee eaku ninye oltung’ani kitok nejoki ninye Isiraeli, “Ekiyieu sii iyiook olkinki ana ilkulikae oshon.”

Neitu apa eitiship Samueli ena bae, kake nejoki Enkai ninye, “Atanyaita Isiraeli anaa oloiguanani lenye. Ore apa anaa nayau ninche aitupuku te Misiri, natunguatie ninche nanu neibelekenya kino. Aserem inkitanyaanyukot. Neaku inchoo ninche ina nayieu. Kake inkoo ninche enaiko lelo aiguanak teneitore ninche aitaa ninche isinkan, neitorogony ninche.

Ore etii nena kikoot, enigil Isiraeli aikilikuanu olaiguanani orik ninche olarrabal. Neitodol Enkai ilo barnoti oji Samueli autaki olbarnoti oji Saulo nebukoki ninye eilata metaa ninye/meitoria Isiraeli.

Neretu Saulo olosho loo Siraeli metimira ilkuti mangati lenye (lelo apa tung’ana otalaikinote Isiraeli aatarai teina kop enkisiligata). Neiteru Saulo aisilig kewan alang enaisilig Enkai. Ore nabo kata, alang’ enaanyu Samueli, olapolosani le Nkai, pee elotu aitayu. Olasarr eton eng’orr olarrabal, neishunye engiriata enye, neureishoyu neitayu ninye openy. Negoro Enkai.

Ore ti ae kata, neirorie eimu Samueli, nejoki Saulo meshomo arasaki Ilmaleki, pee epuo aitalaku elap anaa enapa rasakinoto enye tialo Isiraeli te rishata natulusoyie. Naa ilaseremak apa loo nkitanyaanyukot. Nejoki Enkai, “Eishutu pooki toki o metabaiki inchoo enye.” Kake eitu apa ear Saulo olaiguanani lelelo mangati, neya inkishu napir, neitobirr olperere odamunyeki ninye.
Ore atulusoyie olarrabal, nelo Samueli enetii Saul: Ore pee edolu Saulo ninye nejo “Metamayiani Olaitoriani! Amu ataasa enkitanapata Olaitoriani.
Nejo Samueli, “Kainyioo naa ele toilo loo ntare, o nkishu laningito?” Nejo Saulo, “Ee, eyautua ilewa lainei intokitin naapirr peyie eitakinyie
Olaitoriani, Enkai olasarr. Kake kindipakita kulie tokitin pooki! Kitoning’o Enkai!” “Entung’uai” neitanap Samuel. “Ijojo intae ilasarri enyorr Enkai alang

ening’oto? Aisidai ening’oto alang’ olasarr. Ore eng’olon enkong’u o olwuasa netiu ake anaa eseremata oo nkaitin. Ore amu itemenaitie ororei lo Laitoriani, kitemenayie sii ninye iyie Olaitoriani anaa olaiguanani.” Neibelekenya Samueli ajo alo, neibung Saulo olcholoi lolkila lenye nepolos nejoki Samuel etopolosayie Olaitoriani enkitoria ino taata pee eisho ole latia ino.
Ore enabayie nejo Saulo, “Ayia, ataasa eng’oki. Atigila inkitanapat Enkai.

Aturia apa ole orere naming ninche. Neaku ore taat atasayia, tapalikiaki eng’oki ai nirrinyunye alo tenebo nanu, iyanyitaki tenebo kulo payiani lo lorere lai o tedukuya Isiraeli; wou tenebo nanu, pee alo nanu aserem Olaitoriani.”
Nerrinyo Samueli alo, neserem Saulo Olaitoriani, nesesekuan Samueli olaiguanani loo Ilmaleki tedukuya pooki, neisik, neitu eigil aadua o Saulo.

cbs/ma/olkinki-daudi.title: OLKINKI DAUDI
paragraphs: Ore pee eidip aateshet olng’obor lo Laitoriani nerasaa Enkop Enkisiligata, neton ake egolong’aki iltung’anak loo Siraeli Olaitoriani. Neas pooki ng’ai anaa enaishiakino te dukuya inkonyek enyena. Neany Olaitoriani anaa olaiguanani lenye neiyieuu oopeny olaiguanani lenye maate. Ore olaiguanani le dukuyu, naa Saulo, nemesuj apa Olaitoriani te lulung’ata. Ore enkolong’ nabo neirriwaa Olaitoriani oloiboni lenye Samuel enetii oltung’ani oji enkarna enye Yese te Bethelehem pee eing’oru olaiguanani ogeluno tiatua ilayiok lenyena pokira isiet. Nedamu Samuel ajo kegelu Olaitoriani obo loo layiok sapukin tiatua ninche kake etejo Enkai, “Meneijia. Eing’or tung’ani anaa enaikununo oriong’ kake keing’or Olaitoriani iltauja.” Negelu Olaitoriani Daudi laa ninye olkiti naa olchekut loontare. Nebukoki Samuel ninye eilata aput nelotu engolon o Laitoriani shumata ninye ebaiki ina olong’ neito dukuya.

Ore aa enkiti ayioni Daudi nelo aparan ilalashera lenyena etii olarrabal tenebo Olfilisti. Ore pee ebaiki ilng’obori nedol Goliath ilo Filisti kitok egira aikoroj Isiraeli tenebo Enkai enye tenkaraki etureita enjore pooki erare ninye. Negoro Daudi oleng’ nejoki ilkulikae, “Kaarare nanu ele Filisti.” Ore hoo naa kiti ninye oleng’ nemeiyiolo ataasishore empere o lalem oleng’, kake keyiolo ajo keret Enkai ninye amu ore apa eton egira airrita intare netareto Olaitoriani ninye nemir ing’uesi anaa ilng’atunyo. Ore pee erare Goliath near ninye metuaa tenkopirisiai o soit neisho Isiraeli emirishoi.

Ore pee eaku oloo larin tomoni uni neaku Olkinki tiatua ilarin artam. Ore apa Daudi naa ololarrabal kitok neisiliga Enkai oleng’. Hoo naa etaasa Daudi ing’ok sapukin tiatua enkishui enye kake eirridua ing’ok enyena nepalikini ninye. Ore pee eidip Daudi atimira ilmang’ati lenyena pooki neyau Osanduku lo Sotua atua Yerusalem. Neiyieuu Daudi neshetaki Olaitoriani enkaji kitok. Kake eirriwaka Olaitoriani Daudi olkilikuai ojo, “Mikindim iyie ateshetaki nanu enkaji amu imbukoyie iyie osarge sapuk kake ekeshet olayioni lino ina aji. Kaaisho enkisiligata nchere itum enkayioni naton to lorika le nkitoo intarasi. Kebik enkitoria ino intarasi.” Neisis Daudi Olaitoriani tenkaraki nena kisiligat. Ore hoo duo naa olaing’okoni oiyieu empiris Enkai, oltung’ani apa ninye oata oltau le Nkai.
Neasishore Enkai ninye meigero ilkirempen le seremare tiatua ororei le Nkai.

cbs/ma/eliya-o-loibonok-le-baal.title: ELIYA O LOIBONOK LE BAAL
paragraphs: Ore apa Eliya naa oloiboni yioloti, oirriwayie apa Enkai kopkop e Isiraeli te nena apa olong’I nabore enkarrueisho, naseremitae nkitanyaanyukot terishata e Ahab. Ore tenkaraki eng’oki e Isiraeli, neibonu Eliya olameyu, neitasheyie Enkai enchan too larin okuni. Ore tena rishata neshomo Eliya aisudori tenkaraki Ahab. Ore pee eishunye ilarin okuni lemetii enchan, neigil aitodolu kewan te dukuya Ahab. Ore pee edolu Ahab, Eliya nejo, “Iyie ilo, olaitanyamalani loo Siraeli?” Nejo Eliya, “Eitu nanu aitanyamal Isiraeli. Itaasa ina amu ishomo aserem enkitanyaanyukoto e Baal!” Nejo Eliya, “Inturrurrokoki Isiraeli to ldoinyio le karmel pee kidol Enkai nasipa tenaa Olaitoriani arashu e Baal.”

Ore enkolong nabo nageluno, netii apa ina olaiguanani Ahab tenebo iloibonok iip ong’uan o onom le Baal. Neiturrurro Isiraeli pooki to oldoinyio le Karmel. Neitashe Eliya openy te nkaraki Olaitoriani. Nejoki Eliya olorere, “Entasho maitaki Enkai olasarr metii enkima. Enchoo iloibonok le Baal meitayu sii ninche olasarr metii enkima. Ore ake Enkai nawalu te nkima naa ninye Enkai nasipa.” Nejo olorere pooki, “Ayia! Sidai ina damunoto!”
Ore eyia nejia, ore tadekenya neomon iloibonok le Baal aajo inji, “Oo Baal!

Toning’o iyiook! Irriwaki iyiook enkima! Oo Baal, Toning’o iyiook!” neishirr o metabaiki enkipirata e nkolong’ nemeata entoki nataase. Ore pee eipirr enkolong, neikordodaa Eliya ninche, “ebaiki keirura Baal!” “ebaiki eshomo elototo naado.
Entabuaku oleng’!” neiteru iloibonok le Baal aipidipid nerany, nebuaku aajo lelo oibonok le Baal nedung’udung’ ate too nkalema, nerukunyie osarge. “Oo Baal!
Toning’o iyiook! Irriu enkima! Nebau enteipa, neton ake meata entoki nataase.

Nejo Eliya, “Eidipe! Etaa erishata ai.” Neshetu Eliya olperere, ashetaki Olaitoriani too soito tomon o are. Neyieng oloing’oni neiteleiki ilo perere. Netaru eng’umoto aitaman ilo perere, nejoki ilewa metubukoki iltooi tomon o are abukoki ilo asar. Nebukokino ina are ilo oing’oni, nebukokino lelo keek, nebukokino isoito neaku kedoyo teina gumoto. Neitashe Eliya, neomon “Enkai ai. Intodolu iyie ajo ira Enkai, nara nanu osinka lino.” Ore ina kata ake, nedou enkima naing’uaa keperr, nepejoo ilo asarr pooki, nepej ilkeek, nepej lelo soito, nepej enkare pooki.
Nebuaku olorere, “Olaitoriani! Ninye Enkai!” nejo Eliya, “Entodumu lelo oibonok iip ong’uan le Baal, niariara ninche metuata.” Ore pee eidipayu ina neitoki enchan alotu.

cbs/ma/keliki-iloibonok-enaikununo-olait.title: KELIKI ILOIBONOK ENAIKUNUNO OLAITEJEUNONI
cbs/ma/keliki-iloibonok-enaikununo-olait.scriptureRef: Isaya 7:14, 53:12, Olkerempe le Enkai 16:10, 22:16-18, 41:19, Mika 5:2, Sakaria 11-12, Yeremia 31:31-33, Ezekiel 36:26-28
paragraphs: Neirriu Olaitoriani iloibonok kumok pee eikok iltung’ana le Nkai enaipirta enkiguena Enkai tenkaraki ing’ok enye. Neliki iltung’ana sii enaipirta olng’ur le Nkai teneirridu ninche nepik osiligi lenye atua Enkai. Neitadamu sii ninche enkisiligata o Laitaejeunoni oisiligie apa ninche te rishata nalakua. Nejoki, “Eatae obo laa ninye olotu nelotu aitajeu ntae too ng’ok inyi.” Nejo oloiboni le Nkai Isaya, “Ekeiu ninye eselenkei nemeyiolo olee. Keipoti ninye aajo Emanueli nchere Enkai tenebo iyiook. Ekeipoti sii aajo Olkitok le Seriani. Nebik enkitoria enye entarasi.” Nejoki sii ore ilo Aitajeunoni ketiu ninye anaa olkuo lo lasar, keisilisili kake meng’or ninye kewan, kesukenyi ninye, neye keeya torrono oleng’ pee elak esile pooki oo ng’ok ang’. Kake nejo sii iloibonok kepiu ninye aing’uaa ilootuata.

Neibonu iloibonok kulie baa kumok naasa tenkaraki Olaitajeunoni. Nchere kepuku Olaitajeunoni eing’uaa Bethlehemu, ore inkaik o nkejek enyena naa keremi ninye, kemiri sii te shekeli tomoni uni enkosholai, kekaldaa sii olchore lenye, keshei sii tenebo ilapurrok, neosh inkukuo tenkaraki olkila lenye.

Nelimu sii iloibonok naipirta olning’o ngejuk laa kitabari eimu Olaitajeunoni lo Siligi. Neiro Enkai eimu Yeremia ejo, “Etigila iltung’ana laainei olning’o lai kake ekaitoki aitobir o likae ning’o ngéjuk o ninche. Ekapik inkitanapat aainei atua indamunot enye naiger ninche tiatua iltauja lenye. Ekaaku nanu Enkai enye neaku ninche iltung’ana laainei.”

Nejoki Olaitoriani oloiboni Ezekiel entoki ake naikununo neijia ejo, “Ekaaisho intae oltau ng’ejuk napik enkiyiang’et ng’ejuk atua iltauja linyi; ekaitaiyu tiatua ntae oltau lo soit napik oltau le nkiring’o. Napik Enkiyang’et ai atua ntae naisho intae entusuj inkitanapat aainei.”

Ore pee eidip iltung’ana aatushukoto aashom Yerusalem eing’uaa eararoto e Babylon o enchetata Enkaji e Nkai negira Enkai eitu eitoki airorie ninche tiatua ilarin iip oong’uan. Kake ore teina rishata emoyian o sinaitin ti abori enkitoria o loreren netii kulikae Lyahudi leton ake edamu enkisiligata o Laitajeunoni oyoki alotu. Neaku neanyu ninche ninye te enkisiligata osiligi.

cbs/ma/elikioroto-o-einoto-e-yesu.title: ELIKIOROTO O EINOTO E YESU
paragraphs: Negiroo ilarin iip oong’uan eidipa Enkai airorie Israeli eimu iloibonok. Negira Enkai pi, naa ore Ilyahudi nejing’ atua enkitoria o Ilroma. Kake ore enkolong’ nabo, neitoki airo Enkai! Neirriwaa olmalaika meirorie Zakaria, obo lo lopolosak le Nkaji e Nkai. Neliki ajo ore Elisabet, enkitok enye,naa keiu enkayioni nalotu alimu elotunoto o Laitajeunoni lo siligi. Kake eitu eiruk Zakaria Enkai amu etaa morua ninye o nkitok enye nemeata hoo enkerai nabo. Kake etaasa Enkai enetejo neiu Elisabet enkayioni naji Yohana. Naa ninye olikioo ti ong’ata enaikununo elotunoto o Laitajeunoni.

Ore eidipa ilapaitin ile eirorie olmalaika Zakaria, neitoki Enkai arriu olmalaika oji Gabrieli enkop e Galilaya enkanasa e Nazareti enkaji entito nemeyiolo olee naji Mariamu. Ore ninye naa enkanashe Elizabet. Etisiraki Mariamu olpayian oji Yosef laa ololmarei le Daudi.

Nejoki olmalaika Mariamu, “Takuenya, na kirotet e Nkai.” Ore Mariamu neing’asia neurishoyu. Nejoki Gabrieli “Miurishoyu. Kitamayiana Enkai naa iiu enkayioni nimpot ajo Yesu. Naa keaku kitok neji Oinoti lo Lotii Shumata aisul. Keisho Enkai ninye olorika le nkitoo le Daudi menye lenye. Neitore olgilata le Yakobo intarasi. Nemeiting’ enkitoria enye.”

Ore pee eiyiolou Yosef enaikununo enutai e Mariamu, nemeyieu nesul ninye amu oltung’ani loo sipat neiyieu neleliari aing’uaa. Kake ore eton eitu eas neijia, nelotu olmalaika tenkidetidet nejoki, “Yosef, miurishoyu iya Mariamu anaa enkitok ino amu, ore enutai naata Mariamu eno ltau Sinyati. Naa keiu enkayioni naa impot enkarna enye ajo Yesu, enkipirta enye ‘Olaitoriani oitajeu,’ amu keitajeu iltung’ana lenye too ng’ok enye.” Ore pee edumunye Yosef tenkidetidet enye, nerik Mariamu anaa enkitok enye kake eitu eirrag o ninye eton eitu eini Yesu.

Ore etolusoitie ilapaitin ile etoiwuoki Yohana netaa keisho Mariamu. Ore ina kata nejo olkinki lo Roma inchere lasima ore iltung’ana pooki pee eshuko eneing’uaa too nkuapi enye pee etumi aaikena tenkaraki kodi. Ore Yosef neshuko alo enkanasa e Bethlehem naing’uaa olmarei le Daudi pee etumi aigero tenebo Mariamu.

Neaku kumok iltung’ana ootushukote aapuo Bethlehem neaku metii ewueji neirragie Yosef o Mariamu amu eipute. Neaku enotito olale airragie. Ore etii ine, neiu Mariamu enkayioni neishopoki inkilani e keraisho neirragie te mpeut oo inkishu.

Ore te ina kop netii ilchekuti ootoni aarip intare kewarie. Neipang’aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani neimerlelu esikar o Laitoriani too nkaloli pooki, neiureishoyu ninche oleng’. Nejoki olmalaika ninche, “Emiureishoyu amu ilomon supati le ng’ida kitok ayau, neaku too ltung’ana pooki, amu ore te nkang’ e Daudi, etoiwuoki Olaitajeunoni, te nkaraki intae, laa ninye Kristo, Olaitoriani. Naa ele omonekie te intae; itumutumu elooyo naishopokino nkilani e keraisho, neirragita te mpeut oo nkishu.” Neboitare ilo malaika, olorora kitok le shumata oisis Enkai ejo, “Meisisi Enkai te shumata naisul te pooki, neaku osotua tena kop, too ltung’ana pooki laa ninche eshipakino ninye!”

Ore pee epuo lelo malaika shumata aaing’uaa ninche, nejokino ilchekuti, “Enyeito emaape aabaya Bethlehem, aadol ena bae nataase naitayiolo iyiook Olaitoriani.” Neisarrisar aapuo neinepu Mariamu o Yosef, neirragie elooyo te mpeut. Ore pee edol neinosu ninche lomon ootiaakaki te nkaraki ina looyo. Ore lelo pooki ootoning’o nena naatolimutuo ilchekuti neing’asia. Kake eiteng’ela Mariamu nena baa pooki edamu to ltau lenye. Neshuko lelo shekuti eisho Enkai enkitoo neisis too mbaa pooki naatoning’o o naatoduaa anaa enatiaakaki ninche.

cbs/ma/a.-yohana-olaibatisani-o-eibaluny.title: A. YOHANA OLAIBATISANI O EIBALUNYE YESU
paragraphs: Ore ena naa shakenisho e Yohana te Yesu. Ore pee ebulu Yohana neitayiolo kewon Israel. Nebuaku torpurkel nejo “Erridutu amu etinyikua enkitoria e shumata.” Neibatisa lelo pooki oirridutua tolkeju le Jordan.

Nedumakino ninye isiamon olorere epuo aaning’ nkiteng’enat enyena neibatisai. Kake ore lelo apolosak kituak olaiteng’enak loo nkitanapat, olarikok loo Israeli netobiko ninche te Yerusalem neirriwaki Yohana Olaibatisani ilkiliku lenye. Nejoki ninche ninye, “Iyie doi Kristo?” Newaliki Yohana ajoki, “Mara nanu Kristo.” Neikilikuan aajoki, “Ira Eliya?” Newal Yohana ajo, “A’a’” “Paa ira naa ng’ae!?” Nejoki Yohana, “Ara oltoilo lolobuaku tiong’ata, ‘Entorioi enkoitoi o Laitoriani.’ Etii ilo olotu tesiadi nanu, olaa ninye olkitok tenanu, amu etii ninye tedukuya nanu.”

Ore ake teina rishata, nelotu sii ninye Yesu neibatisa Yohana ninye. Ore ake pee eilepu tenkare, nedou Enkiyang’et Sinyati anaa enturkuluo adoiki ninye, nebolo shumata, nepuku oltoilo te shumata nejo, “Enkerai ai ena nanyor, natishipe teninye.”

Ore tenkolong’ nasujita ina, nedol Yohana Yesu eloito tenebo esiamo kitok, nejo, “Ing’ura! Olkuoo le kerr le Nkai oya ing’ok enkop! Ele taa atolimuo ajo, ‘Ore tesiadi nanu elotu o ltung’ani oituruk tenanu. Ninye olkitok tenanu amu etii ninye tedukuya nanu!’”

cbs/ma/b.-etetema-shetani-yesu-metii-emp.title: B. ETETEMA SHETANI YESU (*METII EMPISHA)
paragraphs: Ore pee eidip Yohana aibatisa ninye, nerikoo Enkiyang’et Sinyati atua orpurkel otii pee erisha Yerusalem o Yeriko. Nebik teine nepukoo inkolong’I artam o nkewaritin artam pee elotu shetani atem ninye. Neitu ninye enya toki nelioo ajo ore etulusoyie ina rishata pooki netiru ninye esumash.
Nejoki Shetani Yesu “Tenaa kesipa ira enkerai e Nkai, oloyala lenye, intodolu naa. Tiaki kulo soito metaa mukateni.”
Kake nejoki Yesu Shetani “Ejo ilkegerot, meishuyie oltung’ani emukate ake, kake pooki rorei opuku tenkutuk e Nkai.”

Nerik Shetani ninye Yerusalemu, neisho ninye meitasho te ntopij enkaji, “Tenaa ira iyie enkerai e Nkai, tusulai kewan enkop! Amu ejo ilkigerot ‘keitanap Enkai ilmalaika pee king’or ninche iyie’. Kejo sii, ‘eikinap ninche too nkaik enye, pee mikinkob osoit enkeju ino’”.
Kake newaliki Yesu, “Kejo sii, ‘mitem iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino’”.
Ore aigil, nerik Shetani, Yesu oldoinyio oado neitodol ninye inkitoriat pooki e nkop o enkitoo. “Enkaisho nanu iyie intoria kuna pooki kitoriat o enkitoo pooki.
Amu aishooki, naa kaidim nanu aishoo iyie arashu likae ake tung’ani ayieu. Keaku inono pooki. Ore ake enias naa pee kigilaki kung aserem nanu.”
Newaliki Yesu ninye te rishata nabayie, “Shomo Shetani, amu etisiraki!
Teserema Olaitoriani Enkai ino aa ninye ake openy.”

Ore pee eidip Shetani atetema ninye ina rishata nelo aing’uaa Yesu nepuonu ilmalaika aisiai ninye. Ore te nkishui enye, netem shetani te ng’oki oshi nataasa iltung’ana … arashu etadamutua pee eas. Kake ore Yesu neirisha aanyare pooki rishata natetemaki shetani ninye, neitu aekata eas eng’oki.

cbs/ma/eipoto-yesu-ilooitengeni-lenyena.title: EIPOTO YESU ILOOITENG’ENI LENYENA
paragraphs: Ore eiding’akino iltung’ana aamanita Yesu einining’u ilomon le Nkai, neitashe Yesu te mbata e naiposha e Galilaya, nedol impeuti are eirrag te mbata e naiposha. Netupukutuo ilarreshok loo sinkir aapuo aaisuj irresheta lenye. Nejing atua empeut nabo, naa ene Simon, nejoki meturrumoi peno aitalam enkop natoyio. Neton Yesu aiteng’en olorere etonita ninye ti atua empeut.

Ore pee eidip airoro nejoki Simon, “Terewa enegut nintadoikiki irresheta linyi enaiposha aaibung’ isinkir.” Nejoki Simon, “Lo Kitok, kitaasishote enkewarie nalulung’a neitu kitum toki, kake ore amu itejo, kaitadoyio irresheta.” Ore pee eiko neijia neibung olkito turrur loo sinkir neiteru aang’era irresheta lenye. Neyuku ilchoreta lenye Yohana o Yakobo otii enkae peut meetu aaret. Nepuonu, neiput impeuti pokira are, o metaa keimis.
Ore pee edol Simon Petero ina nebatata too nkejek e Yesu, ejoki, “Olaitoriani, tung’uayioki nanu amu, kara oltung’ani loo ng’ok.” Amu eing’asie ninye o lelo ooboitare, te nkumoi oo sinkir ooibung’a.
Nejoki Yesu Simon, “Miureishoyu; ore ebaiki taata, iltung’ana intorioo aibung.” Neyau mpeuti enkop natoyio, neing’uaa pooki toki nesuj ninye.
Ore pee elusoo inkolong’i kuti nelo Yesu, nedol oltung’ani osotu kodi oji Lawi (ashu Matayu), eton te wueji nesotunye kodi; nejoki, “Tusujuaki nanu.” Neing’uaa pooki toki, neinyototo asuj Yesu.

Neitoomon Lawi ninye to sirua kitok netii esiamo kitok oo loosotu kodi o kulikae ake oodaa te nebo ninche. Neing’unyung’unyaki Ilfarisayo o lasirak aajo, “Ainyoo pee ing’arierie endaa niokishosho te nebo iloosotu kodi o laing’okok?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Imeyieu iltung’ana biyot olkitari, iloomuoi ooyieu. Eitu alotu aipot lelo supati kake ilaing’okok meetu aairridu.”

Ore nabo olong’, neilep Yesu alo oldoinyo aomon, neton enkewarie pooki eomonito Enkai. Ore pee ekenyu neipot ilooiteng’eni lenyena negelu tomon o aare ti atua ninche nejo ninche Ilkipaareta. Naa Simon (keipoto Yesu ninye ajo Petero) o Anterea olalashe lenye; o Yakobo o Yohana, o Matayo o lkulikai tenebo Yuda Iskariot.

cbs/ma/enkishiunoto-oltungani-oilenya-em.title: ENKISHIUNOTO OLTUNG’ANI OILENYA, EMPALAKINOTO OO NG’OK
paragraphs: Ore pee eidip Yohana aibatisa Yesu, nemanaa Yesu aiteng’enisho te nkanasa o nkanasa. Neaku ore pooki wueji nelo Yesu nesuj ilororani. Neman ninche ninye ometaa keitanyamal oleng’. Ore nabo olong’ nejing’ Yesu enkaji te Kapernaum.
Neiteng’enisho, neiput olorora enkaji oleng’ o metabaiki boo. Neaku kerumisho iltung’ana too lusien oo too nkutukajini enkaji. Negira pooki aaininingu’ inkiteng’enat e Yesu.

Netii apa oltung’ani oilenya otii Kapernaum. Neata ilchoreta oong’uan, nedumu ninche ilo tung’ani oilenye o endapash enye aayaki Yesu. Kake eitu etum ninche empaash pee eitabaiki enetii Yesu. Neaku etakedo ninche shumata enkaji pee eng’er neitadoyio oltung’ani oilenye tedukuya Yesu tenebo endapash enye. Ore ake pee edol Yesu eneba enkirukoto e kulo shoreta nejoki, “Kitapalikiaki ing’ok inono.” Netii ine ilaiteng’enak loo nkitanapat oogira aainining’ Yesu. Ore ake pee ening’ kulo rorei, negorokino Yesu oleng’. Nejo tiatua iltauja lenye, “Kainyoo pee eidim ninye atejo inji? Enkai ake makewan naidim atapalaki ing’ok!”

Kake etayiolo ninye Yesu indamunot enye, nejoki ninche, “Kaa nalelek?” Etenajo nanu, “Kitapalikiaki ng’ok inono,” ana tenajoki, “Inyo! Tudum erruat ino! Shomo ang’!”? Kake ore pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere keeta Enkerai e Tung’ani enkidimata tenkop napalakinyie ng’ok.”

Ina pee ejoki Yesu ilo tung’ani oilenye, “Tudumunye! Tudum erruat ino! Shomo ang’!” Nedumunye oltung’ani alo, nedumunye nabo kata, nedum erruat enye neipung’ alo tedukuya ninche pooki! Neing’asia ninche pooki oleng’ neisho Enkai enkisisa nejo, “Eitu aikata kidol embae enking’asia naaijio ena!”

cbs/ma/eiroro-yesu-enkitok-oo-samaria.title: EIRORO YESU ENKITOK OO SAMARIA
paragraphs: Ore pee elusoo osirua le Pasaka, neshuko Yesu o looiteng’eni lenyena aapuo Galilaya. Neim ninche enkoitoi naimaa enkop e Samaria. Naa keiba apa Ilyahudi Isamaria amu etushulare apa kulikai oreren. Neaku ore too indamunot oo Lyahudi, ore Isamaria naa iltung’ana lemesinyat.

Ore ina kata etii Samaria, nelotu Yesu oo loiteng’eni lenyena enchorro enkare natuturuo apa kakuyiaa lenye Yakobo. Ore pee ebaya erishata endama nenauru Yesu. Neton ayeng’iyeng’a tembata enchoro naokuni, nepuo ilooiteng’eni lenyena olduka aainyiang’u endaa.

Nelotu enkitok oo Samaria enchorro aoku enkare, neng’amaa Yesu ajoki, “Inchooki enkare naok!” Neing’asia enkitok o Samaria. Nejoki ina kitok e Samaria Yesu. “Kaji etiu pee kiomon iyie Olyahudi enkare nara nanu Esamariai?” (Amu mejing’a Ilyahudi o Lsamaria).

Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Tenaa iyiolo enkishorunoto e Nkai naa eing’ai ilo likijoki ‘Inchooki enaok’, anaata aa iyie naomon ninye naa eikincho ninye enkare naishu.” Nejoki enkitok ninye. “Lo kitok, miata toki niokunye negut olkesumet. Ai tiaji iata enkare naishu?”

Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Ore pooki ng’ai ook ena are naa keitoki atir enkure. Kake ore ilo ook ina naisho nanu, nemetir enkure intarasi; amu ore ina are naisho nanu keaku enchorro tiatua ninye naitootuakino enkishui oo ntarasi.”
Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Lo kitok, inchooki ina are, pee maaitoki atir enkure, nemaitoki alotu eneba inji aoku enkare.”

Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Shomo impoto olpayian lino wootu ene.” Newaliki enkitok ajoki ninye, “Maata nanu olpayian.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Intorioko ina nitejo, ‘Maata nanu olpayian.’ Amu imiet ilpayiani likiwaita, neme olino olikiaata taata. Ore tena iroro esipata.” Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Lokitok, adol ajo ira iyie oloiboni.
Eteseremishote loo papa tele doinyo, nijojo intae eji atua Yerusalem etii ewueji nemeata kata nemeseremishoreki.”

Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Kelotu esaa neme te le doinyo, neme te Yesuralem iserememe Papa. Iserememe intai enimiyiololo, nikiserem iyiook enikiyiolo, amu Ilyahudi eing’uaa enjeunoto. Amu kelotu esaa, netaa taata, naserem Ilaseremak oosipa te nkiyang’et o te sipata; amu kitejo lelo oing’oru Papa pee eserem ninye tenkiyang’et e Nkai, ore ilooserem ninye, nenare ake neserem te nkiyeng’et o te sipata.”
Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Ayiolo ajo kelotu Mesia, laa ninye eji Kristo. Na kelotu neboloki iyiook imbaa pooki.”

Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Nanu doi, ele laairorie iyie.” Neing’uaa ina kitok oltoo lenye le nkare tembata enchoro neshuko alo ena anasa aliki pooki ng’ae. “Wootu entodol oltung’ani laatolikio mbaa pooki apa nataasa: Kebaiki naa ele Mesia?” Neshukunye iltung’ana tenebo ninye omeetu enchorro aadol Yesu.
Neiruk ina kata iltung’ana kumok Yesu tenkaraki nena naatejo enkitok. Nesai ninche ninye pee melo aing’uaa ninche neijia. Nebik nkolong’i are teine, neiteng’en

iltung’ana, neitoki aairuk kulikai ake kumok ninye. Nejoki ninche enkitok, “Kiruk taata, kake mme tenkaraki enitejo. Kitoning’okito taata ate kuna baa, nikitayioloito taata nchere ore ele tung’ani naa kesipa ninye Kristo Olaitajeunoni le nkop pooki.”

cbs/ma/eitotio-yesu-iltungana-inkalifuni.title: EITOTIO YESU ILTUNG’ANA INKALIFUNI IMIET
paragraphs: Ore nabo olong’ eboitare Yesu ilkipaareta lenyena nepuonu iltung’ana kumok enetii nemeata erishata nainosie endaa. Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Wootu oopeny emaape eneliyio, ayeng’iyeng’a enkiti kata.”

Nepuo te mpeut ewueji neliyio aa ninche ake oopeny. Kake etodua iltung’ana kumok ninche, neyiolou ninche, neipirri aapuo too nkejek, neng’asie ninche ine wueji. Ore pee edou Yesu te mpeut nedol olorora kitok, neing’urrie ninche, amu etiu anaa intare nemeeta olchekut; neiteru aiteng’en mbaa kumok.

Ore pee emutu, nepuonu ilooiteng’eni lenyena enetii, nejoki, “Keliyio ene wueji, nemuto; intanapa ninche, meshomo kuna ang’itie naamanita ene aainyang’aki ate entoki nanya.” Kake etawalikia ninye ajoki ninche, “Enchoo intae ninche entoki nanya.”
Neing’asi ninche! Nejoki, “Ai! Mikindim! Eikumok kulo tung’ana oleng’!
Mikiata iropiyani naaidip.” Nejoki ninche, “Kaja mukateni niatata intae? Enchom eng’urai.” Ore pee eing’oraa neyiolou, nejoki, “Imiet o sinkir aare.”

Neitanap meitotona olorere too nkujit naanyori, anaa iltimito. Ore pee edumu Yesu nena mukateni imiet o sinkir aare neraposhu inkonyek aing’or shumata, nemayian, nebel imukateni neisho ilooiteng’eni lenyena meishoo lelo tung’ana; neoriki lelo sinkir aare ninche pooki. Nenya pooki neraposho. Nesotu imbelat naatelekuaki o noo sinkir sii neiput inkikapuni tomon o aare. Ore lelo oinosa nena mukateni nera nkalifuni imiet ilewa, netii sii intomonok o nkera.

cbs/ma/eishiunye-yesu-enkayioni-naata-ol.title: EISHIUNYE YESU ENKAYIONI NAATA OLOIRIRUA OIDURUK
paragraphs: Ore nabo olong’, ketii Yesu o ilkipaareta okuni oldoinyo neshukoo enetii ilkulikae ooiteng’eni, nedol emanita olorere kitok, neishankarrarre ilaiteng’enak loo nkitanapat ninche. Ore ake pee edol ilo orere Yesu, neing’asia oleng’, nekuetiki aairoroki. Neikilikuan ajoki ninche, “Ainyoo doi ena shankar niaatata o ninche?” Newaliki oltung’ani obo te ina siamo ajoki, “Olaiteng’enani, atorikuo duoo enkayioni ai enitii, eeta oloirirua lemeiro; olaa ore pee eibung’ nenang’ie enkop; neitayu ilabur, nenya lala neikaolo; najo ajoki ilooiteng’eni linono metaarai, nelaikino.”

Newaliki ajoki ninche, “Wooi ena ishoi nemeeta enkirukoto! Kebaa aton aboitare intae? Kapal intae o anu? Entoriku ninye ene natii.” Nerikokini; ore pee edol ilo oirirua Yesu neiterreyie nabo kata, nebatata ten kop neiperipera, neitayu ilabur te nkutuk. Neikilikuan Yesu menye enkerai ajoki, “Kebaya aa nkat eeta ena pukunoto?” Nejo, “Te kereisho eiterua. Naa katitin kmok etanang’aka ninye atua enkima nenang’anki ankare ejo aar; kake te nindim iyie ataasa ae, ing’urrie iyiook taretu iyiook.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Eji te nindim! Eidimayu imbaa pooki to loiruk.” Nebuak nabo kata menye ina ayioni nejo, “Airuko, ore eneton eitu airuk taretokoki!”

Ore pee edol Yesu olorere ekuetu aasotokino, neing’ode ilo oirirua oiduruk, nejoki, “Lo oirirua ming’ani lemeiro, nanu laaitore, tupuku tung’uai, nimingil ajing’ ae kata.” Nebuaku aishir neiterreyie aipushupush oleng’, nepuku, netiu enkayioni anaa olmeneng’ani o metejo ilkumok, “Ae etua!” Kake eibung’a Yesu enkaina nedumu, nenyototo aitashe. Ore pee ejing’ atua aji, neikilikuan ilooiteng’eni lenyena too iyiook aataaarai ninye?” Nejok, “Meararoyu ena pukunoto ti ae neme te nkomono ake.”

Nepuo te ine neimaa Galilaya. Nemeyieu Yesu neyiolou hoo oltung’ani: amu ilooiteng’eni lenyena eiteng’enita, ajoki, “Eitarasakini Enkerai e Tung’ani nkaik oo ltung’ana, near ninche ninye metua; ore pee eidipi aatar metua, neishari nkolong’I uni nepiu.” Kake eitu ening’u ninche ina natejo, neureyu sii eikilikuan.”

cbs/ma/eitopiwuoki-lazaro.title: EITOPIWUOKI LAZARO
paragraphs: Etii apa emuyei oleng’ oltung’ani oji Lazaro, olalashe le Marisa o Mariamu naa olchore le Yesu. Neirriwaki inkanashera Yesu olkilikuai ejo, “Lo Kitok, ng’urai, emuei oloshi linyor.” Ore pee ening’ Yesu ina nejo, “Mme ene keeya ena mueyian, kake ene nkitoo e Nkai.”

Nenyor apa Yesu Lazaro o inkanashera enye, kake etobiko enetii inkolong’i are eton eitu elo enkang’ e Lazaro tenebo iloiteng’eni lenye. Nelike ninche, “Etua Lazaro, nang’ida nanu te nkaraki intae inchere matii ine, pee itumutumu aairuko. Kake enyeito maape enetii ninye.” Ore pee elotu Yesu nenyorriki etobiko Lazaro te nkurare inkolong’i ong’uan. Ore pee ebaiki enkang’ nedol ajo etii iltung’ana kumok aaitigir inkanashera. Nelotu Marisa enetii Yesu nejoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa itii apa ene anaata eitu eye olalashe lai. Kake ore o taata, ayiolo ajo ore embae pooki niomonu te Nkai, aikincho iyie.”

Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Kepiu olalashe lino aitoki.” Nejoki Marisa, “Ayiolo ajo keitoki apiu te mpiunoto e nkiting’oto.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Ara nanu empiunoto nara enkishui. Ore ilo laairuk nanu, ore ninye te neye, neishu; ore pooki oishu laairuk nanu nemeye intarasi. Iruko iyie kuna?” Nejoki, “Ee Olaitoriani, airuko inchere ira Kristo, Enkerai e Nkai nalotu enkop.” Nelotu sii Mariamu enetii Yesu nebatata too nkejek enyena nejoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa itii apa ene anaata eitu eye olalashe lai.” Ore pee edol Yesu enkurare neishir. Nejo iltung’ana, “Eng’ura eneba enyorrata nanyor ninye!”

Ore pee ebaiki Yesu enkurare nejo, “Ewuang’ie osoit te nkurare.” Ore Marisa nejoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, etong’ua taata, amu inkolong’i ong’uan anaa neye.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Tiniruk iyie nidol enkitoo e Nkai.” Neaku, eiwuang’ie ninche osoit; nedumu Yesu inkonyek aing’or shumata nejo, “Papa aaisho enashe amu kitoning’o pee eiruk kulo tung’ana nchere iyie likirriwua.” Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, nebuak ninye to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Lazaro, tupuku boo!” Nepuku lido otua. Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Entalak too nkarash naanukarieki iltung’ana ninchosho ninye meshomo.” Neaku keiruk iltung’ana kumok Yesu ena olong’.

cbs/ma/a.-yesu-o-lbarnoti-karsis.title: A. YESU o LBARNOTI KARSIS
paragraphs: Ore nabo olong’ eewuo olbarnoti karsis enetii Yesu nejoki, “Olaiteng’enani supat, kaa bae naikishiaan aas pee atum enkishui nemeish?”
Nejoki Yesu, “Ainyoo pee kinkilikuan nanu inenkishiaa? Obo ake eetai aa supat; kake te naa iyieu nijing’ atua enkishui, imbung’a inkitanapat.”
Nejoki, “Akua?” Nejoki Yesu, “Kajo iyilou. Miar metua, miloloito, mipurrisho, minchakenoki elejare. Iyanyita minyi o ng’utunyi, tonyorra ole latia ino anaa kewan.”
Nejoki ilo barnoti ninye, “Aidipa aibung’a nena pooki ebaiki apa ara enkerai: amaa, ainyoo ae naatong’orikia?”
Neing’or Yesu olbarnoti akurraki inkonyek nenyorru nejoki, “Te naa iyieu niaku bayaroti, shomo timira masaa pooki niaata, inchoo ilaisinak, neaku iata olchumati te shumata, nikilotu asuj.”

Ore pee ening’ ilo barnoti ilo rorei, nelo eisinanuo amu eata masaa kumok. Nejoki Yesu ilooiteng’eni lenyena, “Esipa ajoki intae nchere egol pee ejing’ olkarsis enkitoria e keper. Naitoki ajoki intae, kelelek te ntames eim enaudoto o
ltidu alang’ olkarsis ejing’ enkitoria e keper.”
Ore pee ening’ ilooiteng’eni lenyena neing’asia oleng’ nejo, “Aing’ae naa oidim atajeu?”
Nekurraki Yesu nkonyek nejoki ninche “Meidimayu ina too ltung’ana, kake eidimayu pooki te Nkai.”

cbs/ma/b.-nikodemo.title: B. NIKODEMO
paragraphs: Ore nabo olong’ ketii Yesu te Yerusalem te rishata e Pasaka. Eiteng’ena iltung’ana tiatua enkolong’ pooki. Ore teipa, nelo ewueji neiragita. Etii apa oltung’ani lo Lfarisayo oji enkarna Nikodemo. Ore enkewarie, nelotu Nikodemo enetii Yesu, nejoki ninye, “Rabbi, kiyiolo aajo ira iyie olaiteng’enani oing’uaa Enkai; amu meetae oltung’ani oidim ataasa kuna kitoduaat nias iyie te nemeboitare Enkai ninye”
Newaliki Yesu ninye, “Esipa, esipa, aajoki iyie, te neitu eini oltung’ani aaigil te inoto naing’uaa shumata, nemeidim atoduaa Enkitoria e Nkai.”
Nejoki Nikodemo ninye, “Kaji eiko pee eidimi aatoiu oltung’ani etaa moruo?
Keidim ninye atushukokinoyu eniare enkoshoke e ng’otonye metoini?”

Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Esipa, esipa, aajoki iyie, te neitu eini oltung’ani te nkare o te Nkiyang’et, nemeidim atijing’a Enkitoria e Nkai. Ore ina natoiwuoki to sesen, naa osesen, ore enatoiwuoki te Nkiyang’et naa enkiyang’et. Ming’asia te naajoki iyie, ‘Meeta nchere pee miking’ili aaiu.’”
Eton Nikodemu meibung’ enetejo Yesu nejoki ninye, “Kaji eiko pee eidim aataa kuna baa?”

Neaku eitadamua Yesu Nikodemo enaikununo enkatini oo inkera e Israeli apa pee etii tiatua ong’ata tenebo Musa. Neiro ninche imbaa torrok ti alo Enkai o Musa. Neing’unyung’uny ninche ejo, “Kainyoo pee iyaua iyiook aitupuku te nkop e Misiri maetu aaye tene tiong’ata? Amu metii endaa nemetii enkare, neitirika iyiook ena daa nemeeta tipat.” Negoru Enkai tenkaraki engolong’u enye neirriu ilasuriaa oopi atua iltung’ana. Neony ninche iltung’ana o metaa etuata ilkumok.

Nepuonu iltung’ana enetii Musa, nejoki, “Kitaasa iyiook eng’oki, amu kiroro iyiook mbaa torrok ti alo Olaitoriani o tialo iyie; toomono Olaitoriani pee eiwuang’ie ninye ilasuriaa te iyiook.” Neaku etoomonoko Musa iltung’ana. Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Intobira olasurai lo suyai nipik shumata e ng’ape; naa te nelo neony olasurai likae tung’ani, neing’or ninye ilo asurai lo suyai nepok.”

Nejoki Yesu Nikodemo, “Ore anaa enailepie Musa olasurai ti ong’ata meeta nchere pee eitu eilepieki Enkerai e Tung’ani aaiko neijia, paa ore pooki ng’ae oiruk ninye netum enkishui nemeish. Amu etonyorra Enkai enkop aiko nji o meishoru Enkerai enye nabo, paa ore pooki ng’ae oiruk nemeimin kake netum enkishui nemeish. Ore ilo oiruk ninye nemeiguanareki, ore ilo lemeiruk neidipaki aaiguanare, amu eitu eiruk enkarna e Nkerai inoti nabo e Nkai.”

cbs/ma/keituku-enkaingongkoni-inkejek-oo.title: KEITUKU ENKAING’ONG’KONI INKEJEK OO YESU
paragraphs: Neipot oltung’ani obo loo Lfarisayo Yesu pee eitoomon te nkaji enye. Nejing’ enkaji e ilo Farisayoi neton anya endaa.

Naa ng’ura, etii enkitok ina anasa, naa enkaasani oo ng’ok; ore pee iyiolou ajo einosita Yesu endaa te nkaji e ilo Farisayoi, neyau oltulet sidai le ilata narropil, neitashe te siadi ninye too nkejek enyena, neiter aituku inkejek enyena too lkiyio, nejut too lpapit le ndukuya enye, neng’utut nkejek enyena, neelie ina ilata.

Ore pee edol ilo Farisayoi oitoomono nejo to oltau, “Te naa koloiboni le Nkai ele tung’ani anaata etayiolo ajo aing’ae anaa kaa pukunoto e nkitok ena aibung’ ninye!” Neirorie Yesu nejoki, “Simon, aata embae naaliki.” Nejoki, “Ee Olaiteng’enani.”

Nejoki, “Eisilenoko oltung’ani aisilenoni iltung’ana aare eropiyiani enyena, neisho obo indinari iip imiet (matejo inkeek iip imiet), neisho olikae onom (matejo inkeek onom). Ore pee elau pokira aare entoki nalakie, nepalaki pokira aare. Amaa te pokira aare, kalo onyorru ninye oleng?”

Newaliki Simon ajoki, “Ajo, elde otapalakaki nkumok.” Nejoki Yesu, “Etisipa ewalata.” Neibelekenyakino enkitok, nejoki Simon, “Idol ena kitok? Aewuo enkaji ino neitu kincho enkare oo nkejek; kake aaitashala ena kitok inkejek aainei too ilkiyio nejut too lpapit lenyena. Eitu king’utut; ore ninye, anaa duoo pee ajing’u eitu aapal maang’utut inkejek aainei. Eitu kiel endukuya te ilata, kake aaela ninye nkejek te na ilata.
Aajoki naa te nkaraki ina, etapalakaki ng’ok enyena, aa kumok, amu etonyorrishe oleng’, amu ore doi olopalakini nkuti naa kiti enyorrata enye.” Nejoki ninye ina kitok, “Kitapalakaki ng’ok inono.”
Ore lelo ootoni aadaa te nebo ninye neiter aajo maate, “Ai ng’ae ele eji opalaki oltung’ani ng’ok?”
Nejoki ina kitok, “Kintajewuo enkirukoto ino; shomo te seriani!”

cbs/ma/emisa-nabayie.title: EMISA NABAYIE
paragraphs: Ore ena naa enkatini e Endaa o Laitoriani. Kegira apa ilapolosak kitok o ilaiteng’enak loo nkitanapat aing’oru enkoitoi mear Yesu metua. Etijing’a Shetani Yudas Iskariot, olaa obo le lelo tomon o aare, nedumunye alo aning’ore ilapolosak kituaak o sikarini eneiko pee ekaldaa Yesu te ninche. Nenyorraa pee eisho mpesai.

Ore pee ebaya esaa, neton adaa Pasaka, netoni ilkipaareta lenyena te nebo ninye. Nejoki ninche, “Atayiewua oleng’ nanya ena Pasaka te nebo intae eton eitu aaisilisili. Amu ajoki intae, meekure aitoki ai kata anya o meitabari te nkitoria e Nkai... Kake eng’ura amu etii ilo laaitarasaa ena mesa te nebo nanu. Amu eikunari Enkerai e Tung’ani anaa enatejoki apake; kake ee kake aiyia ilo laa ninye oitarasaa!”

Neiteru ilooiteng’eni lenye aaikilikiuana maate, aajoki kalo pasa oiko neijia. Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ilo laisho endung’oti aidipa aitadoiki.” Ore pee eidip aitadoiki, neitayu neisho Yudas Iskariot. Ore pee eidip Yudas atang’amai endung’oti nejing’ Shetani atua ninye. Neaku etiaka Yesu ninye, “Tasioki taasa eniaas.” Ore pee eng’amaa ninye endung’oti neipang’ nabo kata; naa kewarie.

Neaku edumu Yesu emukate, ore pee eisho Enkai enashe nebel neisho ninche ejo, “Osesen lai ele oishoori te nkaraki intae. Entaas ena kidamumu nanu.” Neiko neijia enkikompe eidipa endaa, ejo, “Ore ena kikompe osotua ng’ejuk oitaiki intae osarge lai, oibukori te nkaraki intae te mpalakinoto oo ng’ok.

Ore pee eidipa ainosa emukate naok enkikompe, nejoki Yesu ninche, “Isikisiki ade pooki aailanyisho, kake ore pee aaitopiuni, naituruk te intae alo Galilaya.” Nejo pooki ajo meidim aisika. Ore pee erany osinkolio neipung aapuo olchampa le Gatsemane ti oldoinyo loo Loirienito.

cbs/ma/eomon-te-getsemane-eibungaki-yesu.title: EOMON TE GETSEMANE; EIBUNG’AKI YESU NEIGUENAREKI
paragraphs: Ore pee eidip ainosa emisa e Pasaka, nelotu Yesu o ilooiteng’eni lenye ewueji neji Getsemane nejoki ninche, “Entotoni tene mashomo ende aomon.” Nerik Petero, Yakobo, Yohana ewueji nataana. Nejoki, “Eeta oltau lai osina kitok o metaa kaye; entotoni te ne enchololoto te nebo nanu.” Nelo openy aigut neirrabalaakino enkop neomon nejo, “Papa lai, te naa keidimayu intapaashaki ena kikompe, kake mme anaa enayieu nanu kake anaa eniyieu iyie.”

Nelotu enetii ilooiteng’eni neinepu eirurate, nejoki Yesu, “Amaa ai mindimidimi hoo aaishololoto te nebo nanu esaa nabo? Enchololoto niomono pee mijing’ijing’i intemat; esipa eyieu oltau, kake eshal osesen.” Neitoki alo enkata e are neomon. Neitoki alotu, neinepu ninche eirurate. Neitoki aing’uaa ninche nelo aomon enkata e uni. Neitoki ashukokino ilooiteng’eni lenyena nejoki, “Keton doi ake irurara aayeng’iyeng’a! Eng’ura etinyikua esaa napikieki Enkerai e Tung’ani inkaik oo looata ng’ok. Enyeito emaape; eng’ura, nelde olaakaldaa otabawua.”

Ore eirorita, ng’ura, nelotu Yudas eboitare isikarini laaing’uaa ilarikok oo Lyahudi. Neiroroki Yudas Yesu neng’utut pee eitodol isikarini. Neibung’ Yesu neya enetii ilarikok loo Lyahudi. Neisik ilooiteng’eni le Yesu pooki tenkuretisho.

Neng’as aya Yesu enkaji o Lapolosani Kitok. Nepuonu iltorrok kumok meiteeniki elejare enaikununo Yesu, kake etigire neitu ewaliki Yesu. Neitoki aikilikiuan olapolosani kitok, “Ira iyie Kristo?” Nejo Yesu, “Ee, ara.” Ore pee ening’ neijia nepolos olapolosani kitok ilkilani lenyena nejo, “Ainyoo kintoki aayieunye lchakenini? Itoning’okito ate emoroto namor Enkai. Ijoja aa?” Nedung’oki pooki enkiguana aajo keishiakino keeya.
Ore ake pee ekenyu, neya Yesu enetii olkitok loo Lroma oji Pilato. Neikilikuan Pilato, “Ira doi iyie Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?” Newaliki ajoki, “Ee, kara, kake ore enkitoria aim me ene ena kop.”
Nerik Pilato Yesu neidong’ te nkeene; neiroro Ilyahudi nejo, “Eitu atumie hoo enkitarruorroto.” Kake nebuak Ilyahudi, “Tasho! Tasho!” Neureshoyu Pilato neishoo Yesu meshomo aashe.

cbs/ma/etashoki-yesu-te-salaba.title: ETASHOKI YESU TE SALABA
paragraphs: Ore isikarini o Roma naa etara Yesu oleng’ nepik sii olmarisian loo ilkiku elukunya enye pee esurdaany ninye. Newo osarge te nkomon o ti oriong’. Ore pee eidipa Pilato aishoo isikarini metoriko Yesu metashei, nearaki Yesu anap Osalaba lenye te inkoitoi e Yerusalem. Ore pee enauru oleng’ pee meitoki aidim atanapa, nearaki likae tung’ani anap. Nepuo auluo mpaka endoinyo nataaniki Yerusalem.
Ore pee ebaiki ele doinyo, neshe ninche Yesu tenebo ilapurrok oare. Nepik isikarini ilkeek aare te nkop aikonji anaa esalaba nepik Yesu te dukuya ninche.

Neen naa neudo sii inkaik o inkejek enye to lkeek too lmushumari. Neilepie msalaba shumata nepik te nkumoto meitashe. Neton isikarini te nkop neorikino inkilani lenyena, neoshie enkukuo pee etum oloya.
Ketii iltung’ana kumok aing’orita kuna baa. Netii inkituak naatusujutua Yesu.
Netii sii ilapolosak o ilaiteng’enak oo inkitanapat. Negira aikordodisho nejo, “Eitajeuo ilkulikae nemeidim aitajeu kewan.

Nemor sii olapurroni obo Yesu kake etejo olikae, “Tigirayu amu ore iyiook kitaasa intorrok. Eishiakino pee kiye, kake eitu eas ele tung’ani entoki torrono.” Neliki sii ninye Yesu, “Tadamuoki tinijing’ enkitoria ino.” Newaliki Yesu, “Esipa aajoki iyie, ata taata, ijing’ Paradiso te nebo nanu.”

Neaku saa ile enaipirie enkolong’, nerip enaimin enkop pooki o metabaiki saa naaudo, neimis ewang’an e nkolong’. Ore Yesu, nebuaku to ltoilo sapuk, nejo, “Papa, inkaik inono apik enkiyang’et ai!” Nejo sii, “Eidipe! Ore pee ejo neijia nedung’o tau. Ore ena kata, neiperra nabo kata olkarasha le nkaji e Nkai aaku are, aiteru te shumata o metabaiki abori, neikirikira enkop nedanya ndapidapo. Ore ilo kitok loo sikarini oorripito Yesu o lelo ootii te nebo ninye, pee edol eikirikire enkop o kulie baa naatotiwuo, neureishoyu oleng’ ejo, “Esipa Enkerai e Nkai ele tung’ani.”

Ore too lkuaak lo Lyahudi, meing’uari seseni te shumata o salaba te nkolong’ e sabato. Neomon Pilato metigili ninche inkejek neiwuang’ieki aaya. Neaku eetuo isikarini apa negil inkejek o ilapurrok pee esioki aaye. Kake ore pee epuonu enetii Yesu, nedol aajo eidipa atua, neitu egil inkejek enyena. Kake etaremo osikari obo ematua te remet, nepuku osarge o enkare.

Ore te siadi nena, neisho oloiteng’eni le Yesu olmeneng’ani lenye nepik atua enkurare ng’ejuk neton eitu ae kata eirragieki likae. Neiken to soito sapuk. Ore tenkaraki Sabato enkolong’ nasuja, neirragie Yesu te ine.

cbs/ma/empiunoto-e-yesu.title: EMPIUNOTO E YESU
paragraphs: Etunukayioki Yesu eton eitu edoyioroto enkolong’ Ijumaa, nepik Pilato isikarini oong’uan te nkurare. Neyeng’iyeng’a inkituak naairiamunore Yesu eing’uaa Galilaya enkolong’ nasuja tenkaraki Sabato. Ore te nkolong’ e uni, arashu te enkolong’ e dukuya e wiki, enasirie, nepuo enkurare meitobira osesen le Yesu. Ore pee epuo enkurare nejokino maate, “Ae ng’ae ade oret iyiook aibeleleng’oo osoit te nkutuk e nkurare?” Ore ina kata nejing’ enkikirikirata kitok enkop, amu etadowuo olmalaika lo Laitoriani oing’uaa shumata, nelotu neibeleleng’oo osoit netonie enchumata. Neikirikira ilarripok te nkaraki ninye, netiu anaa ilootuata.

Nejoki ilo malaika inkituak, “Emiureishoyu intae; amu ayiolo ajo Yesu ing’oruru otashoki. Metii ene amu etopiwuo anaa enatejo ninye. Wootu eng’urai ewueji neirragieki. Naa enchom entasiooi entoliki ilooiteng’eni lenyena entiaaki, “Etopiwuo aing’uaa lootuata; neituruko alo Galilaya, naa te ine idolidolo.” Nepuo nabo kata aing’uaa enkurare te nkuretisho o te ng’ida sapuk, nekuet aaliki ilooiteng’eni.

Ore pee ebaiki inkituak ilooiteng’eni lenye, neliki pooki tooki nataase. Kake eitu eiruk ilkumok. Kake nekuet Petero o Yohana enkurare. Ore pee ebaiki Petero enkurare nejing’ nedol ilkarash le kitani eirrag oopeny, nerrinyo alo ang eing’asia te nena naatotiwuo.
Ore pee eshuko enetii ilkulikae looiteng’eni neliki imbaa naatodua.

Neing’asia ilkulikae sii tenkaraki etopiwuo Yesu. Ore pee elusoo erishata dorop neipang’aki Yesu ninche ewueji neisudori maate neitashe ti atua ninche. Neing’asia, neiruk sii! Kake metii oloiteng’eni oji Tomas. Ore pee eliki ninye ajo eipang’anki Yesu nemeiruk, nejo, “Te neitu adol nanu inkiporo oo lmushumaani too nkaik enyena napik olkimojino lai ine wueji oo lmushumaani napik enkaina ai ematua enye, mairuk nanu katukul!

Ore etulusoitie inkolong’i isiet neitoki aatii lelo ooiteng’eni atua aji, netii Tomas te nebo ninche. Nelotu Yesu eikeno nkutukie e ina aji, neitashe te mpolos nejo, “Entaseriana.” Neitoki ajoki Tomas, “Tipika olkimojino lino ene, ing’ura inkaik aainei, nipik enkaina ino ene mbung’a ematua ai nimiaku olemeeta enkirukoto kake iruko.” Newaliki Tomas ajoki, “Olaitoriani lai naa Enkai ai!” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Iruko iyie te nkaraki nikitoduaa nanu? Emayiani lelo leitu edol neiruko.”

cbs/ma/elototo-e-emmaus.title: ELOTOTO E EMMAUS
paragraphs: Ore te ina olong’ ake, juma pili, epuo aare lenye enkang’ naji Emmaus, naa kilomita naapishana ing’uaa Yerusalem, neimaki pokira aare nena baa naatotiwuo. Ore einosaa lomon neinepu Yesu openy airiamariyie ninche. Neikeno inkonyek enye pee meyiolou.

Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kakua omon kulo liimakiki ipuopuo pokira aare?” Neitashe neisinanuo. Ore obo lenye newaliki ajoki ninye, “Keiyie doi ake olomoni te Yersusalem lemeyiolo kuna baa naatotiutuo te ine te kuna olong’i?
Nejoki, “Akua baa?”

“Nejoki ninche ninye, “Mbaa e Yesu le Nasaret, ora apa oloiboni le Nkai ogol, kake eitarasaa ilapolosak lang’ kituaak o laitoriak metudung’okini enkiguana metari metua, neshei ninye. Kake kisilig apa iyiook aajo ninye olaku Siraeli.

Ee pae naa ore etii nena pooki, enkolong’ e uni duoo taata anaa netiu nena baa. Ore sii, etayookito inkituaak tiatua iloiteng’ena lenye enkurare duoo enasirie neitu einepu ilo sesen; neshukunye aajoki iyiook eji etoduaa ilmalaika, ootiaakita keishu. Nepuo sii kulikae lang’ enkurare, nepuo ainepu etiu ake anaa ina natolimutuo nkituaak; kake ninye ake eitu edol.”

Nejoki ninye ninche, “Lo tung’ana moda, nirara yietuti ltauja mirukuruku nena pooki naatejo loibonok le Nkai! Keeta apa kata nemeitamei Kristo aaiko neijia pee ejing’ enkitoo enye?” Neiteru too mbukui e Musa o too loibonok pooki, neibalakinye ninche ilkigerot ooipirta Olaitajeunoni O Siligi.
Ometaa nenyikaki ina ang’ apa napuo. Neiko ninye anaa keyieu negiroo. Kake neibok ninche ninye, aajoki, “Irraga iyiook amu emuto netaa kewarie.” Nejing’ taa aton te nebo ninche.

Ore enya endaa te nebo ninche, nedumu emukate nemayian, negil, neisho ninche. Nebolo inkonyek enye neyiolou ninye; neimisilori ina kata ake neitu eitoki nkonyek enye aadol. Nejokino, “Keitu eyupuyup iltauja lang’ eirorie iyiook te nkoitoi, eboloki iyiook, ilkigerot?”
Neinyototo ake te ina saa nerrinyo Yerusalem; neinepu lelo tomon o obo o lelo ooboitare, ootiaakita, “Etopiwuo taa ninye Olaitoriani neipang’aka Simon!”
Neliki taa ninche nena baa naatotiwuo te nkoitoi, e eneikuna pee eitayiolo kewan ninche ebelaki emukate.

cbs/ma/keipangaki-yesu-ilaitengenak-leny.title: KEIPANG’AKI YESU ILAITENG’ENAK LENYE, ENKILEPATA E YESU
paragraphs: Ore ejoito iloiteng’eni le Yesu imbaa o ilalashera oing’uaa Emmaus, neitashe Yesu makewan ti atua ninche, nejoki, “Entaseriana!” Kake eirriang’a ninche, neureishoyu, ejo koloip etoduaa. Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ainyoo pee inyamalala? Naa kaji etiu pee etii olng’ash iltauja linyi? Eng’ora nkaik aainei o nkejek nchere kewan ai nanu ele; embung’aki pee idolidolo; amu meeta enkiyang’et nkiri o loik anaa kulo lidolitata aata.” Ore pee ejoki neijia, netoidol nkaik enyena o nkejek. Ore eton ake meiruk te nkaraki eng’ida e nking’asia nejoki ninche, “Iatata tene toki nanyae?” Neisho embelati o sinkirri oyiera, nedumu nenya te dukuya ninche.

Nejoki ninche, “Ilapa rorei laainei kulo latiaaka intae, eton atii te nebo intae, inchere ore mbaa pooki naatisiraki aaipirta nanu too nkitanapat e Musa o too loibonok le Nkai o to Lkerempe le Nkai, meeta nchere meitabari. Nebol iltauja lenye metayiolo ilkigerot, nejoki ninche, “Etisiraki aajo, keitamei Kristo naa ore te nkolong’ e uni nepiu aing’uaa lootuata, naa te nkarna enye elikiori enkirridunoto o empalakinoto oo ng’ok loo loreren pooki, neiteruni te Yerusalem. Irara intae shakeni le kuna baa. Naa ng’ura, kairriwaki intae ilo otejo Papa keisho intae; kake entotoni te na anasa, o meishopokini intae engolon naing’uaa shumata.”

Neitoki arik o metabaiki Betania, neilepie nkaik enyena nemayian. Ore emayianita ninye ninche, neilep aing’uaa ninche. Nerrinyo ninche aapuo Yerusalem te ng’ida sapuk, netii anaa ake enkaji e Nkai eisisita Enkai.

cbs/br/oduu-fi-barnoota.title: ODUU fi BARNOOTA
cbs/br/oduu-fi-barnoota.scriptureRef: Dubbi Waaqa ta waan kan waliin deemtu: Nehemia 9:6; Ayubu 38:4-7; Faaru 99:1-3, 103:19-21; Isaya 14:12-15 and 45:12; Ezekieli 28:12-15; Nahumu 1:2-3; Luka 10:18; Yohana 8:44, 12:31; Efeso 2:2, 6:11-12; Kolosai 1:15-16; 1 Timotheo 3:6; 1 Petro 5:8; 2 Petro 2:4; 1 Yohana 3:8; Yuda 6; Mulisani 12:7-9, 20:10
paragraphs: Ato Waaqi nam inuumini, inni maleekota heddu ta isa walliin gubaati galani uume. Maleekoti uumama hafuurati, ta ch’ubbu male uumani. Waaqi akka worri isaa hojjate ammalle isa waqeesuufi uume. Maleekota Waaqi uume keesa, toko, malekota tan irra guddoo qarooma fi midhaaguma qaba. Maqaan isa bakkalcha barii. Waaqi gubbaati bakkalcha barii barchumma gudda kenneefi.

Gaaf tokko bakkalcha barii ufguddise haga Waaqati ufqabe, fula Waaqa fudhachu fedhe. Maleekoti dhibiilleni Waaqan morkite. Ammo Waaqi waan bakkalcha barii fi gulyaatun isa yaadatte imbeekhe. Morkaafi moromaan worra inonfolle waan Waaqi waan ch’ufa beekufi ammalle waan inni bakkalcha barii irra jabeenna qabuufi, isumati isa uume.

Marro ch’ubbuu isaanitiifi, Waaqi maleekota dabditi ch’ufa gubaa gadi gate. Waaqi kha dhugaati ammalle dandae kha isaan morku waliin infidamu. Ammalle Waaqi waan jedhe, guyya tokko maleekota ch’ubbiti ch’ufa adaabe Galaana Ibidaati gata.

Waaqi maqa bakkalcha barii Sheetanaati jijiiree. Hiikan maqa kana “dharticha” jechuu. Sheetanaa fi maleekoti hamaamtuni nyaapa Waaqa taate. Yaada Waaqa akka mormitu iti gamte, haga dandeetu. Amma, maleekoti Sheetana gulyaate sunini, hafuura hama kha laf tan gubba jiru. Worri Sheetan gulyaae ammalle dhugaan morka. Sheetani Dubbi Waaqa ch’aqasu hinfedhu.

cbs/br/uumama-lafaafi-gubaa.title: UUMAMA LAFAAFI GUBAA
paragraphs: Jalqaba
Gaafa qara fiit’e, Waaqi lafafi gubba uume. Gaafasi lafti duwa, fuula inqabdu, aka injirtu. Dukanti d’immu bisaani gubbaa jirti. Ireeni Waaqa guddooni bisaani gubbaa dedeemti.
Guyya Ja’a Kha Uumama

Jennani Waaqi waan jed’e, “Ifsaani ha tahu.” Jennani akasum tahe. Duuba Waaqi ifsaa fi dukana gargari baase. Inni ifsaani “Guyyaa” jed’e ammalle dukanani, “Halkan” jed’e. Waaqi akka ch’ufti dansa inarge. Galgali dabre, diiramillen ind’ufe, kunini guyya qaraati.

Jennaan Waaqi waan jed’e, “Wonti bisaan gubbaati fi kha jala gargari baasa haa taatu.” Isiin akkasum taate. Waaqi waan suniin “gubba” jed’e. Galgali dabre, diiramillen ind’ufe, kunini guyya lameessoti.

Jennani Waaqi waan jed’e, “Bisaan laf gubba jiran ch’ufti haa fula tokooti waltideebianiiti akka biyyeen godduun mulattu.” Isiin akasum taate. Waaqi bisaan woltideebian suniini baarini jed’e, amalle biyye goddu suniini lafa jed’e. Duuba Waaqi akka wonti kunin dansa arge. Duuba Waaqi waan jed’e, “Lafti mukha mimidhago fi mukha dodotii nyaata tolu ch’ufaa ha baftu.” Duuba Waaqi worra eebise akka worri hore lafqabatu. Jennani galgali dabre, diiramillen ind’ufe, kunini guyya sadeesoti.

Jennani Waaqi waan jed’e, “Gubaani ha ifsee ak akaatin guutamtu: Akka ifseeni guddoni, adduuni, guyya mohate, duuba ifseeni didiqooni, ji’aafi urjiini halkan mohatu.” Ammale Waaqi waan jed’e, “Ifseeni tunini ha guyyafi baraafi saati gargari baaftuti.” Inni akka wonti kunin dansa arge. Galgali dabre, diiramillen ind’ufe, kunini guyya afreesoti.

Jennani Waaqi waan jed’e, “Gubbaani ha simpirre fi waan barrisa ch’ufaan guutamtuti, ammalle bisaani ha waan lubbu qaba kha bisaan daakhata heddu d’alani.” Duuba Waaqi akka worri sanyi ufi gula hore lafqabatu eebise. Waaqi akka wonti kunini dansa inarge. Jennani galgali dabre, diiramillen ind’ufe, kunini guya shaneesoti.

Jennani Waaqi waan jed’e, “Lafti ha bineensa aka akaatin guutamtuti: bineensa alaati fi bineesa worra keesati fi, bineesa lafa irra lohullen.” Isiin akasum taate. Duuba Waaqi bineensa kan ch’ufa eebise akka worri horre lafa qabatu. Waaqi akka wonti kunin dansa arge.
Fakeenna Waaqa gula

Jennani Waaqi waan jed’e, “Koota nam mid’asina fakeennafi akheekha keenna gula akka inni uumama ch’ufa mohatu.” Akanaani Waaqi nama uume kha d’iiratifi kha uwaalle ammalle akka worri uumama ch’ufa mohatu ajaje. Amalle Waaqi akka worri hore lafguutu worra eebise. Amalle Waaqi mukha dooti ch’ufa ak sagalee woraa kenne. Duuba Waaqi akka wonti inni uume ch’ufti dansa arge. Jennani galgali dabre, diiramillen ind’ufe, kunini guyya jaesso.
Boqota Waaqa.
Guyya torbesso, Waaqi hujii uumama la obaafate, duuba inboqote. Tanaafi Waaqi guyya torbesso qofa khaae, maan jenaani kunin guyya Waaqi hujii isa ta uumama irra boqote.
TA GABAABINATI HIMAN
Gaafa qara fiit’e, Waaqi lafafi gubba uume. Gaafasi lafti duwa, fuula inqabdu, aka injirtu, ammalle dukanti d’immu bisaani gubbaa jirti. Ireeni Waaqa guddooni bisaani gubbaa dedeemti.

Jennaani Waaqi waan jed’e, “Ifsaani ha tahu.” Duuba ifsaani tahe. Waaqi akka ifsaani suni dansa arge, ifsafi dukana gargari baase. Jennaani Waaqi ifsaani guyya jed’e, dukanaani halkani jed’e. Akanaani galgali tahe diiramileeni tahe. Kunini guyya qara.
Guyya lammeesso, Waaqi bisaan jalaati fi kha gubaa gargari baase akanaani gubba uume.
Guyya sadeesso, Waaqi baarini fi lafa godduu gargarii baase ammalle mukha mimidhaago fi mukha midhaan ak akaa baasu ch’ufa uume.

Guyyaa afreeso, Waaqi ifsaa gubaati uume- akka adduuni guyya mohate, ji’a fi urjillen halkan mohattu. Akka wonti kunini akheekha guyyati fi baraatifi waan kan uume. Guyya shanesso, inni simpireefi qurtummi uume.

Guyya jaeesso, inni waan lam gugurdo hojjate. Ta qara, bineensa fi uumama gosgosa kha laf irra deema ch’ufa uume. Ammalle yo waan lubbu qaba kha akka mukha, simpirree, qurtumii fi bineensa uumu chufa- inni ineebise akka worri horani. Ammalle guyya ch’ufa waan uume ch’ufaan “dansa” jed’e.

Duuba, guyya jaeesolle, akkan jed’e, “Koota nam mid’asina fakeennafi akheekha keenna gula akka inni uumama ch’ufa mohatu.” Akanaani Waaqi nama uume kha d’iiratifi kha uwaalle ammalle akka worri uumama ch’ufa mohatu ajaje. Amalle Waaqi akka worri hore lafguutu worra eebise. Amalle Waaqi mukha dooti ch’ufa ak sagalee woraa kenne. Waaqi akka wonti kunin dansa arge. Kunin guyya jaesso.
Guyya torbesso, Waaqi hujii uumama la obaafate, duuba inboqote. Tanaafi Waaqi guyya torbesso qofa khaae, maan jenaani kunin guyya Waaqi hujii isa ta uumama irra boqote.

cbs/br/a.-uumama-nama-diirati-fi-kha-uww.title: A. UUMAMA NAMA D’IIRATI FI KHA UWWA
paragraphs: Gaafa qara fiit’ee Waaqi lafaafi gubba uumee, guyya jaesso, Waaqi nama d’iiratifi kha uwaalle uume. Inni akkana tolche uume!

Waaqi biyye lafa iraa fuud'e nama tolche, hafuura jireennaa funaaniti afuufe, nami suni sunumaani jiraate lubbu argate. Maqaan isa Adamu. Waaqi oobru Edeni jed’anille infach'aase. Inni mukeeni guddo ilti namaa jaalattu, ta mid'aani isii guddo sagale dansaa oobru suni keesati baase.
